https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ceedee-lam.analysis: Lamb was on the field for a few more plays in Thursday’s loss to the Buccaneers after his injury was announced. Rapoport reports that Lamb is believed to be dealing with a quad bruise, which is not believed to be serious. Lamb and the Cowboys now have over a week to rest up before facing the Packers on Sunday Night Football in Week 6. Barring an unexpected development, we would expect Lamb to be good to go for next week’s game against the Packers at Lambeau Field.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ceedee-lam.headline: Cowboys WR CeeDee Lamb (quad) is questionable to return to Week 5 against the Buccaneers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ceedee-lam.analysis: Lamb departed in the fourth quarter with a quad injury. He tried to return but managed one snap before making his way back to the sideline, coming back on the field later in the drive for a two-point attempt. He was shown on the sideline in visible discomfort following the additional two snaps. Lamb managed to catch just 2-of-5 targets for nine yards prior to departing. Fantasy managers will want to track his status in the coming week, although the additional recovery time could allow him to avoid any missed games.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith caught 11-of-14 targets for 200 yards and two touchdowns in the Eagles’ Week 12 win over the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: Smith was able to bring down an impressive 50-yard touchdown throw from Joe Milton to get the Eagles within two scores. He did the same on a 45-yarder a quarter later in what was easily his best game of the 2026 season. The hamstring issue that has limited Smith as of late did not appear to be an issue Thursday, and he appeared to have some quality chemistry with Milton. Smith is a WR2 on paper for a showdown in Week 13 against the Cardinals, but this effort shows the WR1 upside is palpable.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) practiced in full Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: Smith last week dominated air yards and targets in the Eagles offense in his first game back from a two-month hamstring injury. He should be locked into lineups for Thursday’s matchup against the Cowboys. Dallas has allowed the fourth highest EPA per target to wide receivers on the season. Only five defenses allow more expected fantasy points per game to the position.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is practicing in full ahead of Philadelphia’s Thursday game against the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: We’re expecting the Eagles to force-feed Smith once more after his 57 percent target share on Sunday, leaving him as a plausible WR2 in an elevated matchup against the Cowboys defense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith caught 5-of-12 targets for 41 yards in the Eagles’ Week 11 win against the Steelers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: Returning from a two-month hamstring injury, Smith led the Eagles with a 57 percent target share. No other Eagles pass catcher saw more than five targets. Joe Milton missed a couple easy completions to Smith, one of which would have led to a chunk gain. It was a tough run-out for Smith, who looked fully healthy. Smith will be a solid option next week against a terrible Dallas secondary that was carved up by Cam Ward in Week 11.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is active for Week 11 against the Steelers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: Smith will finally make his return to game action after a two-month hamstring injury. Before the injury, he had accounted for 30 percent of the team’s targets and 47 percent of the team’s air yards. Smith’s 40 percent first-read target share was among the highest in the NFL over the season’s first month. He should be a decent WR3 here with Joe Milton under center. Eagles declared QB Cole Payton, CB Mac McWilliams, LB Smael Mondon Jr., LB Ajani Cornelius, and OL Jake Majors inactive against the Steelers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is not on Philadelphia’s final Week 11 injury report.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: He got in full sessions each of the last two days to clear the report. With Joe Milton under center, Smith is more of a WR3 than a WR2 at this point, but with six teams on bye fantasy managers can’t be choosy.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) practiced in full on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: Excellent news. The Eagles’ No. 1 wide receiver is on track to face the Steelers in Week 11. Although he will be trying to catch passes from erratic QB Joe Milton, Smith’s target volume should keep him in the WR2 tier. It is possible that the team keeps him on a snap count, but he will be featured when he is on the field.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) was limited on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: It sounds like Smith is on track to play in Week 11 against the Eagles, but it would be nice to see him upgrade to full participation tomorrow or Friday. Smith also told reporters today that he was 100 percent healthy for the Eagles’ Week 6 game against the Panthers, but he managed to strain his hamstring again anyway. If active, he will be a WR2 with six teams on bye, catching passes from Joe Milton.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni said he feels “pretty good” about DeVonta Smith (hamstring) returning for Week 11 against the Steelers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: Sirianni also included Dontayvion Wicks in his comments. Smith hasn’t played since Week 6 because of the hamstring issue. In the midst of a lost season, the Eagles almost certainly didn’t feel the need to rush him back. He will return to a team down to its third-string quarterback in Joe Milton. Smith will be in the WR2 mix if he’s cleared for Week 11.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: Eagles declared WR DeVonta Smith, WR Dontayvion Wicks, LB Jihaad Campbell, CB Jonathan Jones, S Michael Carter II and WR Britain Covey inactive for Week 9 against the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: Smith has now been active just one time since Week 3. With the Eagles no longer particularly interested in the 2026 season, we would consider Smith no better than 50-50 to return following the team’s Week 10 bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.headline: Javonte Williams rushed 28 times for 101 yards and two touchdowns in the Cowboys’ Week 12 loss to the Eagles while adding three receptions for 22 yards and a receiving score.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.analysis: Williams ran in for two scores in the first half, and then was able to just get into the end zone on a connection with Dak Prescott for his third score of the first half. The second-half was quiet for the tailback, but the damage was done while reaching 15 total scores on the season. Williams will be in the RB1 conversation, even with the sledding likely significantly tougher against the Seahawks in Week 13.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.headline: Javonte Williams rushed 18 times for 67 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys’ Week 11 win over the Titans, adding three receptions for 24 yards and a second score.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.analysis: Williams lost some mop-up work to someone named Jashaun Corbin but cleared 20 touches for the fourth time in five games. The touchdowns were his 11th and 12th of the season, and give him 25 in 27 appearances as a Cowboy. Williams continues to not provide efficiency, but that’s not what’s needed opposite the Cowboys’ elite receiver duo. Williams needs to finish drives at the goal line and do a little bit of everything else, and that’s what he has been doing. Williams will be a low-end RB1 for Thanksgiving Day against the Eagles.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.headline: Javonte Williams rushed 16 times for 63 yards in the Cowboys’ Week 10 loss to the 49ers, adding one reception for four additional yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.analysis: Williams wasn’t particularly efficient in this one, averaging just 3.9 YPC, with his longest run coming on a nine-yard gain late in the game. Williams saw half of his rush attempts come on the Cowboys’ first two drives of the game, but was mainly an afterthought in the second half when the Cowboys entered the fourth quarter trailing 31-19. The negative game script certainly didn’t help Williams in this one, but his volume continues to keep him in the RB2 conversation. He’ll look for better results in Week 11 when the Cowboys take on the Titans.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.headline: Javonte Williams rushed 20 times for 101 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys’ Week 9 win over the Colts, adding 23 yards on four receptions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.analysis: Williams notched his second 100-yard game of the season, tacking on a fourth quarter score with less than two minutes remaining to push his fantasy production into RB1 territory. Week 9 also marks the third straight week in which the Cowboys utilized a new-look, run-heavy game plan, this time utilizing Tyler Goodson to soak up carries behind Williams. Williams has now seen 20 or more carries in three straight and will remain a volume-based RB1 in a difficult matchup against the 49ers at home in Week 10.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.headline: Javonte Williams rushed 24 times for 56 yards in Dallas’ Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.analysis: Woof. The Cardinals simply overwhelmed the line of scrimmage with run blitzes and dared the Cowboys to do something about it; they often didn’t. Williams also fumbled away a goal-line tote only for it to wind up as a Cowboys touchdown by landing in the hands of journeyman tight end James Mitchell. Things should be easier next week against the Colts, where Williams will remain a reasonable RB1/high-end RB2 tweener.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.headline: Javonte Williams rushed 25 times for 155 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys’ Week 7 win over the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.analysis: Williams churned out consistently positive gains against the injury-riddled Eagles but took off in the fourth quarter, gaining over 60 yards in the final frame. He cashed in for fantasy managers with a touchdown with just over two minutes remaining on the clock to push his line into elite territory, despite failing to notch any receptions. The career high in yardage on the ground comes after the Cowboys averaged the fewest rush attempts per game during the first six weeks of the new season. Williams gets a sparkling matchup against the Cardinals at home in Week 8, where he’ll return to RB1 status in fantasy circles following the eruption against the Eagles.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.headline: Javonte Williams rushed 11 times for 41 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys’ Week 6 loss to the Packers, adding nine yards on two receptions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.analysis: Williams has now been held to 3.8 yards per carry or fewer in five of six games and 45 yards on the ground or fewer in four of six games, with seven combined touchdowns keeping his fantasy value afloat through the first third of the regular season. Williams has now seen 12 or fewer carries in four of six contests to start the year. The good news is that the Cowboys have no choice but to keep riding Williams until the wheels fall off considering the general lack of depth in the backfield, meaning there are likely to be better days ahead for the veteran back. He gets another middling matchup on the ground against the division rival Eagles in Week 7, where he will be a volume-driven RB2.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.headline: Javonte Williams rushed 12 times for 45 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys’ Week 5 loss to the Buccaneers, adding 17 yards on two receptions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.analysis: Williams has now averaged 3.8 yards per carry or fewer in four of five games, keeping his fantasy value afloat via six combined touchdowns through five weeks. While the touchdown equity is solid in one of the league’s most potent offenses, we’re liable to see more down weeks like the one he put forth against the Buccaneers unless, or until, the Cowboys can fix their woes on the ground. Williams did see all but one running back opportunity in this one, keeping him in the top six in backfield opportunity rate through Week 5. Consider Williams a volume-aided and touchdown-aided RB2 ahead of a Week 6 meeting with the reeling Packers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.headline: Javonte Williams rushed 19 times for 62 yards and three touchdowns in the Cowboys’ Week 4 win over the Texans, adding five catches for 21 yards on his only five targets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.analysis: Williams had a very easy rushing score — his first one where he only had to beat one defender to the outside after a pair of pulls. He also had a very hard one, where he dragged several Texans defenders into the red zone. The Cowboys didn’t run the ball much, but when they did it was effective. Williams was averaging 5.1 yards per tote before the second half, where he simply lived in the goal-to-go set. He’ll be on the low-end RB1 line in Week 5 against a Jalon Daniels-led Bucs outfit on Thursday night.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.headline: Javonte Williams rushed 19 times for 98 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys’ Week 3 loss to the Ravens, adding two receptions for five yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/javonte-wi.analysis: The Cowboys drew up a lot of carries for Williams early in this one. The 26-year-old back totaled seven carries for 45 yards on his team’s first two possessions, and punched in a two-yard score late in the fourth quarter to put the Cowboys up 10-0. Williams would mostly be bottled up by the Ravens after his score, but he did break free for a 22-yard run in the third quarter that helped set up a Brandon Aubrey field goal — which was blocked. This is undoubtedly the best game of the season for Williams, who hadn’t gone for more than 41 yards in either of his first two games. That said, he still struggled at times to get going on the ground, as seven of his carries went for two or fewer yards. His volume remains reliable enough to keep him in the RB2 conversation for next week’s game against the Texans.

https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.headline: Joe Milton completed 21of-31 passes for 331 yards with three touchdowns and an interception in the Eagles’ 39-38, Week 12 win over the Cowboys while adding 15 yards and a touchdown on the ground.
https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.analysis: Milton certainly isn’t boring. He even showed off some impressive touch at times, but the most impressive throw was a bomb that went 58 yards in the air for a score to DaVonta Smith. He nearly matched that dart with another 45-yarder to Smith in the third quarter as he lived up to the Bazooka Joe nickname. He even showed off some scrambling ability, particularly on a 15-yard scrambling into the end zone in the middle of the fourth quarter. The only real mistake was a forced throw with the Eagles down eight on the next possession, but he followed that up with a brilliant 24-yard throwing score to Makai Lemon. He made enough plays on the final drive to get the Eagles into field-goal range, and complete a three-touchdown comeback win. It was a vastly improved effort for Milton over the Week 11 contest versus the Steelers, albeit it against a significantly worse defense. Milton will likely get the start in Week 13 against the Cardinals, and offers a wide range of potential fantasy outcomes.

https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.headline: Joe Milton completed 11-of-21 attempts for 141 yards in the Eagles’ Week 11 win against the Steelers, adding five rushes for six yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.analysis: Milton was in game manager mode as the Eagles maintained a lead throughout thanks to the team’s suffocating defense against Aaron Rodgers and the collapsing Steelers offense. Milton was not asked to do much, and he didn’t. He targeted DeVonta Smith — returning from a long injury absence — a team-high 12 times, missing him on a couple routine throws in the second half. Unless the Eagles face runaway negative game script, Milton won’t hold much fantasy value. He gets a good matchup next week against the Cowboys.

https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.headline: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni announced Joe Milton will start in Week 11 against the Steelers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.analysis: Milton struggled in the Eagles’ loss to the Giants before their bye. Maybe an extra week of prep will result in a better performance, though we don’t have our hopes up. Milton threw for 169 scoreless yards on 34 attempts. He took seven sacks and lost a fumble. On the bright side, Milton added 64 yards with his legs. That will keep him in the QB2 mix for Superflex purposes this week, but nothing more.

https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.headline: Joe Milton completed 18-of-34 passes for 169 yards in the Eagles’ 19-11, Week 9 loss to the Giants, adding nine carries for 64 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.analysis: Making the first official regular season start of his career, third-year pro Milton also took a whopping seven sacks for 41 yards and a lost fumble. He never felt Arvell Reese’s pressure when he was obliterated in the second quarter and put the ball on the ground. It was, unsurprisingly, a somewhat ugly day, though Milton was also victimized by drops, including a really awful muff late in the fourth quarter by Makai Lemon. Elijah Mitchell also scrambled a potential game-scoring drive when he failed to get out of bounds to stop the clock. All in all, today would not be surprising to anyone familiar with Milton’s game. He flashed arm strength, running ability, and highly questionable game management skills. Now headed on bye before a Week 11 date against the Steelers, Milton is not a must hold in superflex leagues where other QBs actually find themselves on the wire.

https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.headline: NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo reports that Joe Milton will be the Eagles’ starting quarterback in Week 9 against the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.analysis: Milton, 26, has spent time with three different teams since the Patriots drafted him in the 2024 NFL Draft’s sixth round. He is a towering, mobile, cannon-armed quarterback with enticing traits. His erratic play can also be frustrating. Milton can be added in two-quarterback leagues, though his range of potential outcomes in his first start is extremely wide. He replaces Tanner McKee after a three-game starting stint.

https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.headline: Eagles signed Joe Milton, formerly of the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.analysis: Milton will join Tanner McKee and rookie Cole Payton on the Eagles’ 53-man roster. This move comes a day after it was revealed that Jalen Hurts would be out indefinitely due to a superficial blood clot that could sideline him for the next several weeks. Milton will likely serve as the Eagles’ emergency third QB on game days and seems unlikely to see any playing time at this point.

https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.headline: Cowboys signed QB Joe Milton to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.analysis: Milton initially made the 53-man roster but was let go after the initial wave of waiver claims. He went unclaimed when waivers ran Tuesday and now returns to the Cowboys on the practice squad. With Sam Howell winning the QB2 job, Milton will be QB3 heading into the season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.headline: Joe Milton was not claimed on waivers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.analysis: He’ll likely catch on with a practice squad in the next day or two, perhaps with the Cowboys again. Milton had initially made the 53-man roster in Dallas but lost his spot when they claimed Emari Demercado off waivers. The 26-year-old has an arm that was made to play quarterback and a decision-making process that was made to play quarterback in 1975.

https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.headline: Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer said Sam Howell and Joe Milton will compete for the No. 2 quarterback job this summer.
https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.analysis: This is mostly just a housekeeping item for dynasty managers, but re-draft managers can still file it away for a potential rainy day in Dallas. Things could change via the 2026 NFL Draft, but these two are set to duke it out for now. Milton flubbed his second-half opportunity in Week 18 last year, perhaps prompting the Cowboys to search for a more reliable No. 2 option. The team certainly has a type. Both Howell and Milton possess very strong arms, which should allow the Cowboys to continue attacking downfield if starting QB Dak Prescott were to miss time.

https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.headline: Joe Milton III completed 7-of-13 passes for 73 yards and an interception in the Cowboys’ 34-17, Week 18 loss to the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/joe-milton/000.analysis: A year after destroying the Bills’ backups in the final game of the 2024-25 season, Milton failed to deliver the same kind of fireworks here. He started the second half for the Cowboys and led five drives, only one of which resulted in points. He’ll finish the season 15-of-24 for 183 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions, while adding four rushes for 45 yards. He will return as Dak Prescott’s backup in 2026.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.headline: Dak Prescott completed 19-of-27 passes for 291 yards and two touchdowns in the Cowboys’ 38-36, Week 12 win over the Eagles, adding 19 yards on the ground with a rushing score.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.analysis: The NFC East is something, folks. Prescott had a big day even with a couple of long runs overturned due to penalty, and some “hidden yardage” due to pass interference that put the Cowboys into scoring position. He fired a pair of touchdowns to running backs in the first half and helped Dallas build a 28-10 lead going into the half. The Cowboys would blow that lead in spectacular fashion, and Prescott took a horrific sack to set up good field position before the game-winning field goal for Philadelphia. He will try and keep the good statistical run going in Week 13 against the Seahawks in a Monday Night Football matchup.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.headline: Dak Prescott completed 28-of-33 passes for 325 yards and four touchdowns in the Cowboys’ 51-30, Week 11 win over the Titans, adding four carries for nine yards and a fifth touchdown.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.analysis: Prescott totaled 10 touchdowns from Weeks 4-9. He’s now matched that total over his past two starts, including nine scores through the air. Today he found “the usual” of CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens and Javonte Williams for scoring strikes while tacking on role player Brevyn Spann-Ford. Prescott’s touchdown on the ground was a lunge for the pylon where he was initially, confusingly labeled out of bounds. He was not, and the Cowboys’ unstoppable offensive effort marched on. Playing his best football just in time for Thanksgiving, Prescott will have the opportunity to stay hot vs. a short-handed Eagles D. Things then get dicier for fantasy managers, with the Cowboys visiting Seattle in Week 13 before an unseasonably late Week 14 bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.headline: Dak Prescott completed 30-of-51 passes for 343 yards, five touchdowns, and one interception in the Cowboys’ 46-40, Week 10 loss to the 49ers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.analysis: Facing a Niners offense that scored a touchdown on six of its 11 possessions, Prescott and the Cowboys needed to be nearly perfect if they hoped to keep pace. Dak orchestrated an 11-play, 71-yard drive on the Cowboys’ second drive of the game, capping it with a 35-yard touchdown pass to George Pickens, who found the end zone a career-high three times in this one. Prescott’s two touchdown passes in the first half had the Cowboys trailing 17-16 at halftime, but after being outscored 14-3 in the third quarter, Prescott and the company aired it out 24 times in the fourth quarter as they aimed to keep pace. Prescott threw a five-yard touchdown to Pickens to get the Cowboys within seven points, and responded on the following drive with an 11-yard touchdown pass to Ryan Flournoy to cut the Niners’ lead to 38-32. Unfortunately, that would be as close as the Cowboys would get, as the 49ers would need just two plays to go up by double digits, which proved to be too much for Dallas to overcome, even after a one-yard touchdown pass to CeeDee Lamb. This is the kind of game the Cowboys are capable of posting any given week, especially if they are being pushed by the opposing team. We wouldn’t expect Cam Ward and the Titans to push them next week in the way the Niners did this week, but Prescott will be in the QB1 mix in what looks to be a plus matchup at home.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.headline: Dak Prescott completed 21-of-34 passes for 335 yards and two touchdowns in the Cowboys’ 27-23, Week 9 win over the Colts, adding one yard on two carries.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.analysis: The two teams played to a maddening field position battle through the first three quarters in what was one of the least disciplined games in recent memory, including a multitude of penalties on key downs, two turnovers, and a missed field goal from the Cowboys. A poor fourth quarter saw the Colts snatch the lead with a late field goal, but a 46-yard deep connection with Ryan Flournoy on the play of the subsequent possession allowed the Cowboys to take the lead with just over a minute remaining in the fourth quarter. A Caleb Downs interception ended the game, allowing Prescott and the Cowboys to escape with a win to send them to 4-5 as they chase the Giants in the NFC East. Up next is a home test against the 49ers in Week 10, where Prescott will remain a back end QB1.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.headline: Dak Prescott completed 19-of-29 passes for 195 yards and a touchdown in Dallas’ 33-30, Week 8 loss to the Cardinals, adding seven carries for 20 yards and a touchdown on the ground.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.analysis: If you’re wondering, it was Prescott’s first rushing touchdown since Week 12 of the 2025 season against the Eagles, and his first game with seven carries since Week 5 of the 2025 season. The gist of it is: The Cardinals big blitzed a lot and vacated several underneath zones to allow Prescott to run. Dallas often tried to solve things pre-snap, and they often did — but not often enough to win. Dallas was either throwing haymakers or quickly finding themselves going three-and-out, as they did in overtime. Prescott will get to rebound quickly in Week 9 against a Colts outfit that barely qualifies as a serious football team amid what has the look of a fire sale.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.headline: Dak Prescott completed 15-of-27 passes for 212 yards and three touchdowns in the Cowboys’ 38-21, Week 7 win over the Eagles, adding eight yards on two carries.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.analysis: Prescott made the throws when they counted while connecting on three touchdowns to his two alpha receivers, two to CeeDee Lamb and one to George Pickens. After averaging the fewest rush attempts per game through the first six weeks of the regular season, the Cowboys leaned heavily on Javonte Williams against a battered Eagles team; Williams set a career high with 155 yards on the ground. Even so, Prescott did not look his best, nor did the pass offense. Lamb committed two drops and the team benefited from multiple first downs due to penalty. Prescott gets another sparkling matchup against the Cardinals at home in Week 8, where he remains a fantasy QB1.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.headline: Dak Prescott completed 34-of-54 passes for 258 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions in the Cowboys’ 23-13, Week 6 loss to the Packers, adding seven yards on two carries.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.analysis: Prescott and the Cowboys were completely unable to get anything going prior to the half, managing just 92 yards of total offense while taking a 17-point deficit into the break. They would force a three-and-out to start the third quarter and follow it up with a touchdown drive to get on the board, but a punt and two turnovers on downs left them trailing by 16 until a late score inside of two minutes remaining in the final frame. Prescott’s two interceptions occurred deep in Green Bay territory in the second quarter, removing much needed points from the scoreboard in what was then a tight game. The loss drops the Cowboys to 2-4 and looking up at the Giants for the division lead through a third of the regular season. Prescott will be a back-end QB1 on the road against the division rival Eagles in Week 7.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.headline: Dak Prescott completed 24-of-42 passes for 316 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions in the Cowboys’ 24-16, Week 5 loss to the Buccaneers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.analysis: The two interceptions on Dak’s ledger were both in-and-out of his receivers’ hands, the second of which hit tight end Jake Ferguson in the face mask to allow the Buccaneers to ice the game in the fourth quarter. The first “pick” bounced off the hands of Ryan Flournoy to allow the Buccaneers to establish an 11-point lead at the beginning of the third quarter, a deficit the Cowboys would be unable to overcome. That said, Prescott wasn’t at all at his sharpest, missing numerous throws wide in addition to a few badly under-thrown balls in the second half. To make matters worse, alpha wide receiver CeeDee Lamb departed the game in the fourth quarter with a quad injury. The Cowboys fall to 2-3 and find themselves looking up at both the Giants and Eagles ahead of a Week 6 meeting with the Packers at Lambeau. Prescott returns to QB1 status in what has become a soft matchup, pending the health of Lamb.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.headline: Dak Prescott completed 32-of-45 passes for 335 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys’ 34-30, Week 4 win over the Texans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.analysis: He had just 87 passing yards at halftime, but the Cowboys turned up in a major way in the second half by peppering CeeDee Lamb with targets and getting George Pickens matched on Kamari Lassiter to their benefit. Prescott was surgical against the blitz and led a game-winning drive after C.J. Stroud briefly put the Texans up 30-27, leading the Cowboys 74 yards in 1:43 by brutalizing the Texans’ zone coverage. Dak should remain in the QB1 ranks next week against the woeful Buccaneers on Thursday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.headline: Dak Prescott completed 25-of-40 passes for 276 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys’ 34-31, Week 3 loss to the Ravens.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dak-presco.analysis: Dak and the Cowboys came out with a run-heavy approach early, but Prescott was efficient through the air when given the chance. He was able to get both CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens involved in this one, with the two receivers combining for 14 receptions for 194 yards on the day. Prescott’s lone touchdown pass came on a 19-yard strike to Jake Ferguson in the third quarter to cut the Ravens’ lead to 24-21, but on the Cowboys’ final drive in the fourth quarter, he would go 3-of-6 passing for 36 yards while adding another nine yards on the ground to help set up a game-tying field goal by Brandon Aubrey. A literal last-second field goal moments later would give the Ravens the win, but Prescott and the Cowboys have now gone for 30-plus points in back-to-back weeks. He’ll be a fringe QB1/QB2 in next week’s game against the Texans.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.headline: Chiefs declared RB Kenneth Walker, QB Garrett Nussmeier, CB Melvin Smith, DT Omarr Norman-Lott, T Diego Pounds, OL Jaylon Moore and DT Marcus Harris inactive for Week 13 against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.analysis: Walker will miss at least one more game while dealing with his groin strain, meaning Emmett Johnson should be the workhorse against the Buffalo defense. Nussmeier will be the emergency third quarterback.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.headline: NFL insider Jordan Schultz reports Ken Walker (groin) is out for Week 12 against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.analysis: Walker was always going to be a long shot to suit up for KC’s Thanksgiving night game against Buffalo. This will be the third straight game in which Walker has been sidelined, leaving Emmett Johnson as the team’s workhorse back for at least one more week. Johnson over the past two weeks is fourth in rush yards, ninth in explosive run rate, 14th in rush yards over expected per attempt, and fourth in missed tackles forced per attempt. In other words, he’s good. Johnson will be a top-10 option against the Bills.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.headline: Kenneth Walker (groin) was limited in Tuesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.analysis: This is at least the start of a movement for Walker to be active for Thanksgiving’s game against the Bills. It’s his first practice since suffering the groin injury. His status on Wednesday will be one of the biggest fantasy storylines of the week as it also underscores whether Emmett Johnson will be an RB1 or a contingency FLEX play. It’s hard to read too much into this one way or another, with Andy Reid saying early today that Walker “feels good” probably the best bellwether we have at this point.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.headline: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Ken Walker (ankle) will participate in practice Tuesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.analysis: “I’m not anticipating a ton of work,” Reid said of Walker, who has missed two straight games and did not practice Monday ahead of the team’s Thanksgiving matchup against Buffalo. “Let’s see how does. He’s feeling pretty good.” If he practices today and Wednesday, Walker should be active for Thursday night. The Chiefs have committed to Walker as the team’s lead back despite Emmett Johnson putting up elite numbers in his absence. Johnson would be startable only in deeper fantasy leagues if Walker is good to go for Thursday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.headline: Kenneth Walker (groin) was listed as DNP on Monday’s estimated injury report.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.analysis: This wasn’t the news fantasy managers were looking for after going without Walker for each of the last two weeks. The Chiefs’ RB1 has been sidelined with a groin injury he suffered ahead of Week 10’s game against the Falcons, but there was early hope it would be a one-game absence. It was widely believed the decision to sit him against the woeful Cardinals was made to give him additional time to heal up before Week 12’s game against the Bills, but Monday’s DNP now draws his availability against Buffalo into question. The Chiefs didn’t officially practice today, but Walker would not have been present if they did. If he can’t get on the field in even a limited capacity on Tuesday, it would be fair to say he’s trending in the wrong direction ahead of Thursday’s marquee matchup. If Walker is unable to play, Emmett Johnson would be a fringe RB1 after strong performances in back-to-back weeks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.headline: Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy said Kenneth Walker (groin) will “remain the starter” when he returns.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.analysis: Rookie Emmett Johnson has rushed for 45-206-1 in two games without Walker this season, which has led some to wonder what role Walker could have when he returns from his groin injury. Walker, who currently ranks fifth in the league in rushing yards (872) and leads the league in yards per carry (5.5) could return as early as this Thursday when the Bills play host to the Chiefs on Thanksgiving, and from the sound of things, it would be safe to say he will be in line for plenty of work. Speaking Monday with the media, Bieniemy said that while Johnson has been impressive in his two games as a starter, the Chiefs “also understand the value [Walker] brings as well.” His practice status will be one to monitor this week, but if he’s active, Walker would be an easy must-start in what could be a high-scoring affair.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.headline: Chiefs declared RB Kenneth Walker (groin) inactive for Kansas City’s Week 11 game against the Cardinals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.analysis: It’s Emmett Johnson szn once more. Also inactive for the Chiefs are QB Garrett Nussmeier (third quarterback), OL Jaylon Moore (ankle), OL Trey Smith (concussion), DT Omarr Norman-Lott (knee), DT Peter Woods (neck) and CB Melvin Smith. Norman-Lott and Woods were both questionable and will not play. The others were ruled out on Friday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.headline: Chiefs ruled out Kenneth Walker (groin) for Week 11 against the Cardinals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.analysis: The Chiefs face the lowly Cardinals this week, but they face the Bills next week. Allowing Walker to fully heal in time for that important matchup makes sense. Stud rookie Emmett Johnson remains a fantasy football RB1 after an explosive showing against the Falcons last week. Walker will vault back into the RB1 tier upon returning.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.headline: Kenneth Walker (groin) did not practice on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.analysis: It’s looking like it will be another RB1 ranking for Emmett Johnson against the Cardinals this week. Walker has not been on the field for either of the first two practices of the week and if there’s a coach on the team or a #SourcedMen claiming he has a real chance to play, we haven’t seen it yet.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.headline: Ken Walker (groin) did not practice Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kenneth-wa.analysis: It’s looking more and more like Walker will miss a second straight game with his groin issue. NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport said Tuesday that he wouldn’t be surprised if Walker sat again in Week 11 against the Cardinals. “He had a sore groin (last week). It’s getting better,” head coach Andy Reid said. “We just don’t want to do something stupid. ... He’s feeling better.” Emmett Johnson, fresh off a monster outing in Week 10, would get another start and profile as a top-5 fantasy option. Johnson will face a Cardinals defense allowing the fifth lowest fantasy points per opportunity to running backs this season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.headline: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed 21 times for 205 yards and three touchdowns in the Lions’ Week 12 loss to the Bears, adding five receptions for 47 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.analysis: Gibbs is the most valuable player in fantasy football, regardless of format. Since scoring twice from one yard out isn’t enough for him, Gibbs ripped off a clean 70-yard touchdown run on the Lions’ ninth drive — and that probably wasn’t his most impressive play. One drive earlier, Gibbs took a run to the right side, and multiple Bears defenders broke past the offensive line. One got a hand on him, but he changed direction and took off for a 32-yard gain down the sideline. The impending 2026 league-winner should be treated as the overall RB1 in Week 13 against the Falcons’ beatable run defense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.headline: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed 23 times for 98 yards in the Lions’ Week 11 win over the Bucs, adding four catches for 20 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.analysis: The Buccaneers did a good job bottling Gibbs up for three quarters, but you can only keep him out of the end zone for so long. Gibbs punched in a one-yard score late in the fourth quarter to functionally seal the game. After a quick turnover-on-downs from the Bucs, he put the final nail in the coffin with another goal line touchdown. Gibbs entered the game tied for the league lead in touchdowns from scrimmage at 13. Now Christian McCaffrey needs to find the end zone twice to keep pace. Still putting up gaudy numbers every week, Gibbs is the unquestioned RB1 overall for his Week 12 game against the Bears.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.headline: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed 22 times for 153 yards and two touchdowns in the Lions’ Week 10 win over the Patriots, adding seven catches for 99 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.analysis: Gibbs gashed the Pats for chunk gains at will, averaging seven yards per carry and over 14 yards per catch. The Lions’ line bludgeoned New England and Gibbs was untouchable in open space. Gibbs could have posted even better numbers had the Patriots’ offense pushed the pace of this game more. Even without much pushback from New England, Gibbs racked up 44.2 PPR points, which is just shy of the highest mark in a single game this year. He’s running away with the RB1 overall crown, especially with Kenneth Walker banged up. Per usual, Gibbs will be the top-ranked option at his position when he takes on the Bucs next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.headline: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed 20 times for 74 yards and a touchdown in the Lions’ Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.analysis: This was easily Gibbs’ worst fantasy outing of the year, though that largely speaks to just how incredible he has been in 2026. The big difference today was a lack of receiving usage. Gibbs was only targeted once and failed to catch a pass for the first time since Week 4 of the 2024 season. Jared Goff only attempted 25 passes, but that would still result in more than one target for Gibbs on a normal day. We’re willing to write this off as the product of a low-scoring rock fight with the Dolphins. Gibbs will be back at the top of the RB1 ranks for his Week 10 date game against the Patriots.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.headline: Sione Vaki had 11 rushes for 65 yards in the Lions’ Week 8 win against the Vikings, adding one catch for five yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.analysis: It was the first time this year Vaki has seen more than six carries. The Lions went ultra run-heavy in this one to combat the Vikings’ vexing blitz scheme, which led to 35 carries on the day. Vaki should be stashed in most formats in cae Jahmyr Gibbs misses any time in the coming weeks. Vaki would be a potential 20-touch weekly option in such a scenario.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.headline: Jahmyr Gibbs had 23 rushes for 153 yards and a touchdown in the Lions’ Week 8 win against the Vikings, adding two catches for 15 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.analysis: Like all Minnesota opponents this season, the Lions got nothing going through the air. They resorted to a run-heavy game plan and shredded the Vikings defense on the ground for 228 yards. The rushing attack was led by Gibbs, who popped a handful of chunk runs in the second half after the Lions had mostly given up on attacking the Vikings through the air. This is Gibbs’ third 100-yard rushing effort of the 2026 season. His centrality in the Detroit offense makes Gibbs an elite play every week. He’ll take on the Dolphins in Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.headline: Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) will play in Week 8 against the Vikings.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.analysis: Like teammate Amon-Ra St. Brown, Gibbs started the week off with a missed practice before upgrading to a full participant in both sessions to end the week. He was removed from the injury report Friday and will be ready for a normal workload against the division rival Vikings Sunday. Fantasy managers are clearly starting Gibbs, regardless of matchup.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.headline: Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) practiced in full Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.analysis: The return to practice comes on the heels of a missed practice Wednesday for the veteran workhorse, immediately putting fantasy managers at ease for Week 8. Managers will want to confirm his practice status Friday before making final preparations for the weekend, but it certainly appears as if Gibbs will be good to go for a normal, and massive, workload when the Lions take the field against the division rival Vikings.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.headline: Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) did not practice Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.analysis: A DNP to open the week would normally be concerning, but Dan Campbell told reporters earlier today that he was going to get a lot of players “off their feet” during today’s practice. Gibbs appeared to injure his leg while awkwardly sliding to the ground on his final carry of Week 7. The fact that he isn’t listed with a leg injury on today’s report is also a good sign. Sione Vaki is the next man up if Gibbs can’t play this week, but we aren’t overly concerned quite yet. Tomorrow’s injury report will be more telling.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.headline: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed 29 times for 116 yards in the Lions’ Week 7 win over the Packers, adding five receptions for 27 additional yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahmyr-gib.analysis: Fantasy managers won’t balk at what was an overall solid performance, but they probably would have liked to see Gibbs rush in a touchdown; the Packers were more than willing to give him one late in the fourth quarter. Gibbs intentionally fell short of the end zone twice on the Lions’ final drive to ensure Jake Bates’ game-winning field goal attempt would be the final play in regulation, which worked to the Lions’ advantage in the 20-17 win. Gibbs ripped off multiple chunk gains in this one, with 13 of his 29 carries going for five or more yards. He did lose a fumble deep inside Packers territory near the end of the second quarter, which likely cost his team at least three points, but as usual, Gibbs was a big reason why the Lions constantly found themselves in position to win. It’s worth noting that on his final play of the game, Gibbs appeared to suffer a knee injury when his left leg bent awkwardly as he attempted to stop and fall to the turf to keep the clock running, but he was able to jog off under his own power. We would ultimately expect him to be fine, but his practice status will be one to monitor this week as the Lions prepare to take on the Vikings. Assuming he is good to go, Gibbs will be an obvious RB1 candidate next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.headline: Sam LaPorta caught 4-of-5 targets for 44 yards and one touchdown in the Lions’ Week 12 loss to the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.analysis: The Lions’ No. 1 tight end generated multiple double-digit gains today, including an 11-yard touchdown on a hitch-and-go just before halftime. He played through his ankle injury without issue after beginning the week limited in practice, notably diving to make a 17-yard catch. LaPorta is a TE1 against the Falcons next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.headline: Sam LaPorta (ankle) is not on the final injury report and will play in Week 12 against the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.analysis: LaPorta began the week with a limited session before upgrading to full on Tuesday. The Lions’ No. 1 tight end should play a full complement of snaps in what will likely be a high-scoring game environment on Thursday. He should be in fantasy football lineups.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.headline: Sam LaPorta (ankle) practiced in full on Tuesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.analysis: LaPorta profiles as a TE1 option in a game with a juicy 55.5 over/under on Thanksgiving. This full session should assure that he skips the questionable line and proceeds directly to a fun game script in the early window.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.headline: Sam LaPorta (ankle) was listed as limited on Monday’s estimated practice report.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.analysis: The ankle appears to be a non-issue, assuming LaPorta can manage to participate in practice Tuesday. The team will hold two more sessions ahead of Thursday’s divisional showdown against the Bears on Thanksgiving, a game that will decide which team stands alone atop the competitive NFC North with six weeks remaining in the regular season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.headline: Sam LaPorta caught 3-of-6 targets for 62 yards in the Lions’ Week 11 win over the Bucs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.analysis: Coming off a month of quiet showings, this goes down as a rebound for LaPorta, even if it doesn’t do all that much for fantasy managers. LaPorta tied for a team-high in targets and trailed only Jameson Williams in yards. The only downside to his performance is that Brock Wright and Tyler Conklin combined for three catches and 60 yards. With a Thanksgiving shootout versus the Bears on tap, LaPorta will get one more game in the TE1 ranks for Week 12.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.headline: Sam LaPorta caught 1-of-4 targets for 16 yards in the Lions’ Week 10 win over the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.analysis: LaPorta’s slump continued with another quiet outing today. Backup tight end Brock Wright out-produced him in PPR formats with two catches for 11 yards, albeit on just two targets. He has nine catches for 99 yards over his past four appearances. With so many mouths to feed in the Detroit offense, LaPorta is increasingly looking like the odd man out. He will get one more week in the TE1 ranks. If things don’t turn around versus the Bucs in Week 11, fantasy managers might need to explore other options.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.headline: Sam LaPorta caught 4-of-5 targets for 32 yards in the Lions’ Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.analysis: LaPorta was the only Lion outside of Amon-Ra St. Brown to catch more than two passes. He accounted for a fifth of Jared Goff’s targets, but the team’s low-volume passing approach meant there wasn’t much volume to go around. LaPorta has gone cold in recent weeks with three straight games under 40 yards. He’ll look to get back on track as a mid-range TE1 versus the Patriots next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.headline: Sam LaPorta caught 3-of-5 targets for 33 yards in the Lions’ Week 8 win against the Vikings.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.analysis: LaPorta had a quiet day against a Minnesota defense that has shut down opposing tight ends for much of the season. He had at least 80 receiving yards in each of that past two Detroit games. LaPorta had been a serviceable starting tight end headed into Week 8, and should have a better outlook in Week 9 against the Bills. He’s been targeted on 18 percent of his routes on the season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.headline: Sam LaPorta caught 1-of-2 targets for 18 yards in the Lions’ Week 7 win over the Packers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.analysis: While Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jameson Williams combined for 244 yards and two touchdowns, LaPorta was an afterthought in the Lions’ offense on Sunday. LaPorta’s first target didn’t come until late in the fourth quarter, and his first catch came in the fourth quarter on an 18-yard play. It was an uncharacteristically underwhelming game by LaPorta, who entered the day coming off two-straight games in which he topped 80 yards and found the end zone. Despite the dud performance, LaPorta will be in the TE1 ranks next week at home against the Vikings.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.headline: The Athletic’s Jonathan Jones reports “it’s more likely than not” that the Lions work out an extension with TE Sam LaPorta before free agency.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-laport.analysis: According to one of Jones’ sources, Lions GM Brad Holmes “does not like losing his draft picks, especially high ones.” A second-rounder in 2023, LaPorta made waves earlier this week when he expressed frustration with his lack of a contract extension on the Pardon My Take podcast. While those frustrations persist, the 25-year-old tight end clarified some of his comments to local Detroit media Friday, reiterating his desire to stay with the Lions long-term. Jones notes that other extensions the Lions have handed out have taken some time to get done. He also cautions that the team shouldn’t wait too long to sign LaPorta as the Raiders are unlikely to waste time making Brock Bowers the highest-paid tight end in football when he becomes extension-eligible after the season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.headline: Jameson Williams caught 6-of-9 targets for 68 yards in the Lions’ Week 12 loss to the Bears, adding one rush for 12 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.analysis: The Lions got Williams involved on crossers, corners and screen passes today, but a few missed connections proved costly. Jared Goff targeted Williams in the end zone on the opening drive, but the pass fell incomplete. On the Lions’ fifth drive, Williams got behind the defense, but stumbled slightly, resulting in an overthrow instead of a long score. On the Lions’ 10th drive, Williams was unable to secure a third-down target at the Bears’ 25-yard line and accidentally tipped the pass to a Bears safety instead. That said, Williams deserves credit for generating a 39-yard gain on a corner route that helped set up Sam LaPorta’s touchdown just before halftime. Williams remains a volatile WR2 in Week 13 against the Jaguars.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.headline: Jameson Williams caught all four of his targets for 93 yards and a touchdown in the Lions’ Week 11 win over the Bucs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.analysis: Williams busted his two-game slump with a 57-yard score in the third quarter. As he tends to do, Williams simply blew by the Bucs’ defense on a deep shot and saw nothing but grass in front of him. Despite the strong fantasy outing, Williams still finished fourth on the team in targets, behind all of the usual suspects. Williams has been one of the most frustrating fantasy options this year, but managers have to stick with him through the lulls to find spike weeks like today. He will be in the WR2 mix for a potential shootout with the Bears next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.headline: Jameson Williams caught 4-of-7 targets for 50 yards in the Lions’ Week 10 win over the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.analysis: Williams didn’t post an elite box score, but he did earn his highest target total since Week 7. The speedster earned a healthy 22 percent target share and finished second on the team in receptions, tied with Amon-Ra St. Brown. Williams has generally been a boom/bust wideout, but he has at least 40 yards in all but two games this year. He’ll remain at the top of the WR3 ranks when he takes on the Bucs next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.headline: Jameson Williams caught 1-of-2 targets for 31 yards in the Lions’ Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.analysis: We’re not sure if a player can be due for a catastrophic bust of a fantasy week, but “Jamo” was probably due for a catastrophic bust. He came into this game red hot, with 208 yards and five touchdowns over his past three games. Given Williams boom/bust nature, a flop was always right around the corner. He also dropped one of his two targets, which didn’t help his cause. The Lions get a potential shootout with the Patriots next week, meaning fantasy managers can safely keep Williams in their lineups as a WR3 despite today’s quiet outing.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.headline: Jameson Williams caught 4-of-6 targets for 70 yards and a touchdown in the Lions’ Week 8 win against the Vikings.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.analysis: Williams scored the Lions’ lone passing touchdown on a short corner-of-the-end-zone grab in the first half. Williams was second behind Amon-Ra St. Brown in targets, functioning as the primary downfield threat with a nice 46-yard catch on a Jared Goff shot down the middle. Williams, who came into Week 8 with the 16th most air yards among wide receivers this season, should remain in lineups next week against a vulnerable Buffalo secondary that has struggled against boundary wideouts.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.headline: Jameson Williams caught 5-of-9 targets for 91 yards and two touchdowns in the Lions’ Week 7 win over the Packers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.analysis: Williams wasted little time getting involved early in this one. On the Lions’ fifth play of the game, he ripped off a 24-yard gain to the Packers’ 16-yard line. On the next play, Williams came in motion and snuck out of the Lions’ backfield to turn a short pass into a 16-yard score, giving the Lions their first points of the day. Williams would find the end zone again in the third quarter on a 10-yard touchdown, and on the following drive, he nearly scored again. Were it not for a Packers defender knocking him out of the back of the end zone on a catch, we would have seen a hat trick. Williams’ big-play ability was on display all night, as three of his five receptions went for 15-plus yards. Williams now has back-to-back two-touchdown performances to his name and has gone for 90-plus yards in two of his last three games. His volume continues to be inconsistent, but Williams is capable of breaking any game open at a moment’s notice. He will be a fringe WR2 in what could be a tough Week 8 matchup against the Vikings.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.headline: Jameson Williams caught 2-of-4 targets for 47 yards and two touchdowns in the Lions’ Week 5 win over the Cardinals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.analysis: The Lions’ speedster only caught two passes today, but he made them count. Williams’ first catch was a nine-yard, fourth-down touchdown on the Lions’ fifth drive. He nearly hauled in a 25-yarder via a play-action target on the sixth drive, but Cardinals CB Max Melton batted it away. He was open for an explosive gain on the next drive, but Jared Goff checked down to Sam LaPorta about 10 yards beneath Williams. A few plays later, Williams dusted his coverage defender for a 39-yard score from bunch formation, hauling in the touchdown pass in stride in the end zone. Goff later gave him another touchdown chance on a downfield throw targeted inside the Cardinals’ five-yard line, but Williams couldn’t secure it. He’ll now take a week off with the Lions’ Week 6 bye, but return as a WR2 against the Packers in Week 7.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.headline: Jameson Williams caught 6-of-8 targets for 102 yards in the Lions’ Week 4 loss to the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.analysis: Fantasy managers had suffered through three down games with the middle-round pick before Williams was able to take advantage of a Carolina secondary missing its top two corners. He was kept out of the end zone for the fourth consecutive contest to start the 2026 season but returned his first fantasy-viable outing on the backs of 52 Jared Goff pass attempts. While that level of volume is unlikely to be the norm for the Lions, a Week 5 meeting with the Cardinals provides another opportunity for Williams to return value in a potential shootout. Williams will be an upside WR3.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.headline: The Detroit Free Press’s Dave Birkett reports Jameson Williams will not face assault charges stemming from an incident with a woman on August 6th.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.analysis: The incident was reported to the police earlier this month. Jeff Wattrick, spokesman for the Oakland County Prosecutor, told Birkett, “Based on the facts presented to us at this time, the Novi Police and our office jointly concluded that there is no cause to file charges against Mr. Williams.” Williams has been an off-field headache for the Lions since entering the league, but it doesn’t sound like this latest incident will be an issue. He will be on the field for the team’s Week 4 date with Carolina.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.headline: Jameson Williams caught all four of his targets for 49 yards in the Lions’ Week 3 win over the Jets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jameson-wi.analysis: Drew Petzing schemed up a few short and intermediate looks for Williams, but he still finished with a measly 12.5 percent target share. Both Jahmyr Gibbs and Amon-Ra St. Brown saw eight targets. Williams has topped out at four catches through three weeks. His 49 yards today are a season-high. Williams closed the 2025 season as an every-week WR2, maybe even more. That usage has all but disappeared to start the 2026 season. He is tumbling back into the WR3 ranks heading into the Lions’ Week 4 game against the Panthers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.headline: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught 7-of-10 targets for 146 yards in the Lions’ Week 12 loss to the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.analysis: St. Brown shot out of the gates in this one, generating two explosive plays on the Lions’ opening drive. He needed a breather after being sandwiched between two Bears defenders on a deep completion on the Lions’ third drive. He played through a ribs issue a couple of weeks ago, and may reappear on the injury report with the same issue next week. Despite the hard hit, St. Brown stayed hot and continued ripping off long gains. A Bears defensive back committed pass interference against him on a target thrown to St. Brown right at the goal line. The ball fell incomplete, but the penalty setup one of Jahmyr Gibbs’ rushing touchdowns. St. Brown remains an elite WR1 against the Falcons in Week 13.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.headline: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught 5-of-6 targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in the Lions’ Week 11 win over the Bucs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.analysis: With only 28 attempts for Jared Goff, there simply wasn’t much receiving work to go around. St. Brown still led the Lions in targets alongside Sam LaPorta. Despite the quiet day, fantasy managers will be satisfied with St. Brown’s eighth touchdown of the year. He scored No. 8 on an easy strike over the middle of the field from 14 yards out. With a shootout versus the Bears scheduled for Thanksgiving, St. Brown is set for elite fantasy numbers in Week 12.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.headline: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught 4-of-5 targets for 98 yards and two touchdowns in the Lions’ Week 10 win over the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.analysis: St. Brown got things started early with a 56-yard catch-and-run that saw him make nearly half of the New England defense miss. Not content with one score, St. Brown plowed into the end zone on a 22-yard screen early in the third quarter. It was an electric homecoming of sorts for ARSB, who spent part of his childhood in Germany and holds German citizenship. St. Brown hadn’t scored since Week 3, so the double-dip today will be much appreciated by fantasy managers. He will remain near the top of the WR1 ranks when Detroit takes on Tampa Bay next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.headline: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) is active for Week 10 against the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.analysis: No surprise here. St. Brown is good to go as a mid-range WR1 for Week 10. Sione Vaki is also active. Inactive for the Lions are CB D.J. Reed, C Cade Mays, DB Keith Abney II, LB Amen Ogbongbemiga, DT Mekhi Wingo, and EDGE Ahmed Hassanein.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) is expected to play in Week 10 against the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.analysis: St. Brown played through the rib injury last week. He remained limited in all three practices before this week’s game. He’s likely not at full strength, but there was never much risk of him missing today’s game. He remains a high-end WR1.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.headline: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) is questionable to play in Week 10 against the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.analysis: St. Brown was listed as questionable in Week 9 after practicing in a limited capacity all week. He managed to suit up on game day, posting an 8/86 receiving line. He was limited in all three practices this week and once again got hit with the questionable tag. We expect him to play. He should be treated as a WR1, as usual, assuming he is active.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.headline: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) was limited in Thursday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.analysis: He played through this last week, managing an 8/86 line against the Dolphins. We’d be surprised if he wasn’t removed from the injury report tomorrow after getting in two limited sessions on Wednesday and Thursday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.headline: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) was limited on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.analysis: St. Brown played through the injury without issue last week, catching eight passes for 86 yards. The Lions’ No. 1 wide receiver should be treated as a WR1, as usual, against the Patriots in this week’s international game. St. Brown will likely upgrade to full participation on Thursday or Friday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.headline: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught 8-of-10 targets for 86 yards in the Lions’ Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.analysis: St. Brown was questionable for today’s game with a rib issue. You wouldn’t know it by his usage. He ran circles around the rest of the Lions’ pass-catchers with a 38 percent target share. He led the team in yards from scrimmage and accounted for just shy of half the team’s passing production. St. Brown remains a strong WR1 option ahead of his Week 10 game against the Patriots.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.headline: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) is active for Week 9 against the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/amon-ra-st.analysis: No surprises here as this was reported earlier today. St. Brown remains a top-flight WR1 for his matchup with the Phins. Sione Vaki is also active and will serve as the team’s RB2. Inactive for the Lions are CB D.J. Reed, EDGE DJ Wonnum, C Cade Mays, RB Jacob Saylors, TE Jordan Meeks, DL Mekhi Wingo, and EDGE Ahmed Hassanein.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.headline: Jared Goff completed 25-of-36 passes for 313 yards, one touchdown and one interception in the Lions’ 35-39, Week 12 loss to the Bears, adding three rushes for 10 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.analysis: Goff’s first career Thanksgiving interception was not his fault. Jameson Williams tipped the pass right into Bears S Dillon Thieneman’s hands. Goff played very well on the day, and looked unstoppable whenever he targeted Amon-Ra St. Brown. Goff nearly tacked on a second passing touchdown on a trick-play pass to OL Larry Borom in the end zone, but the pass unfortunately fell incomplete. Goff remains a locked-in QB1 next week against the Falcons.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.headline: Jared Goff completed 20-of-28 passes for 279 yards and two touchdowns in the Lions’ 31-21, Week 11 win over the Bucs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.analysis: A long Bucs drive limited the Lions to one possession in the first quarter. Jake Bates missed his field goal try, resulting in a slow start for Detroit. They shook the rust off in the second quarter and cruised past the Bucs over the next three frames. Because Tampa’s offense didn’t put up much of a fight, Goff’s passing volume was limited once again. He hasn’t thrown for more than 32 passes in a game since Week 4. The good news for fantasy managers is that the Lions take on the Bears in what should be a Thanksgiving afternoon shootout next week. Goff topped 330 yards in both of his games against the Bears last year. He will be a top-half QB1 for Week 12.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.headline: Jared Goff completed 20-of-31 passes for 303 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions in the Lions’ 35-10, Week 10 win over the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.analysis: The Lions’ offense faced almost no resistance from New England. Goff averaged 9.8 yards per attempt and Jahmyr Gibbs ran for seven yards per carry. Goff did, however, force two throws that simply weren’t there. Both came in the second quarter, and the second pick was in the back of the end zone, costing the Lions at least three points. On the whole, it was still business as usual for one of the league’s best offenses. Goff gets a tough matchup versus the Bucs next week, but that won’t knock him out of the QB1 ranks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.headline: Jared Goff (chest) practiced in full on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.analysis: That should alleviate any concern that he’d miss Sunday morning’s Munich kickoff against the Patriots. Goff will be a low-end QB1 for that one assuming no major negative news hits on Friday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.headline: Jared Goff (chest) was limited on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.analysis: Goff had his worst game of the year in the Lions’ Week 9 win over the Dolphins. Perhaps this injury was bothering him. On the plus side, Goff is already practicing in a limited capacity, so we do not expect it to impact his availability for Week 10 against the Patriots. It is worth monitoring his practice participation level this week, though.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.headline: Jared Goff completed 17-of-25 passes for 170 yards and an interception in the Lions’ 19-9, Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.analysis: The Lions undoubtedly played down to their opponents in this game, putting up six points in the first half before finding slightly more success after the break. Things got off to a rocky start with an easy interception for Dolphins defensive back Chris Johnson. Goff was hit as he threw the ball and it wobbled right into Johnson’s arms. The Lions had one drive go for more than 50 yards. Jahmyr Gibbs punched in the score at the end of the drive, taking home the only Lions touchdown of the day. Goff should have no issues turning things around against the Patriots next week. He will remain near the top of the QB1 ranks for Week 10.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.headline: Jared Goff completed 18-of-25 attempts for 176 yards, a touchdown, and an interception in the Lions’ Week 8 win against the Vikings.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.analysis: Goff, like all quarterbacks against the Vikings, seemed lost from start to finish, unable to decipher to intricate Vikings blitz scheme. He was sacked four times and saw pressure on seemingly every drop back before the Lions abandoned the pass game for the run game in the second half. Sunday marked only the second game this season in which Goff did not have multiple touchdown throws, and the first time he has not eclipsed 200 passing yards. Goff should be able to get back on track next week against a bad Dolphins defense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.headline: Jared Goff completed 22-of-32 passes for 303 yards and two touchdowns in the Lions’ 20-17, Week 7 win over the Packers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.analysis: In a game that felt like it should have featured far more points, Goff and the Lions narrowly walked away with the win. He led an explosive opening drive that included a 28-yard pass to Amon-Ra St. Brown and a 24-yard pass to Jameson Williams, and ended with a 16-yard touchdown pass to Williams to put the Lions up 7-0 early. Goff would again connect with Williams for a 10-yard touchdown pass in the third quarter, and narrowly missed linking up with him for a third touchdown when Williams was forced out of the end zone on a catch on fourth-and-five from the Packers’ six-yard line. Goff did lose a fumble in this one on a botched snap exchange with his center, but it was an overall strong outing for the Lions’ signal-caller. Goff has yet to throw an interception this season and has now thrown for over 300 yards in three of his six games this season. He’ll be a fringe QB1/QB2 next week at home against the 6-0 Vikings.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.headline: Jared Goff completed 19-of-30 passes for 271 yards and three touchdowns in the Lions’ 45-21, Week 5 win over the Cardinals, adding one rush for a one-yard touchdown.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.analysis: Sacks and a few errant throws under pressure derailed the Lions’ first three drives. Goff got things back on track after that, guiding the offense to seven straight scoring drives, including six touchdowns. He even punched in a one-yard rushing touchdown via a quarterback sneak, marking his first rushing score since 2023. Goff could have boosted his passing yards total with a likely explosive gain by targeting an open Jameson Williams on the first drive after halftime, but he instead checked down to Sam LaPorta in the flats for an eight-yard pickup. The Lions are on bye in Week 6, but Goff will be a locked-in QB1 against the Packers in Week 7.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.headline: Jared Goff completed 32-of-52 passes for 412 yards and one touchdown in the Lions’ 32-26, Week 4 loss to the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jared-goff.analysis: Goff has now thrown a touchdown pass in 27 straight contests, a streak that started in the team’s Thanksgiving day contest against the Bears in 2024. He could move into sixth on the all-time list for consecutive games with a touchdown pass should he throw for at least one touchdown in each game this season. He came within four minutes of breaking that streak against the Panthers, needing a late touchdown to tight end Sam LaPorta to keep it alive in a game the Panthers dictated with their defense throughout. Goff also maintained his clean sheet of no interceptions thrown to start the season but it wasn’t enough to overcome a defense that ceded 445 yards of total offense to a Panthers team without two of their top three wide receivers in Jalen Coker and Xavier Legette. The Lions fall to 2-2, now two games behind the division-leading Vikings through the first month of play. Goff remains a surefire QB1 ahead of a potential shootout against the Cardinals in Week 5.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.headline: Salvon Ahmed rushed three times for 50 yards in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions, adding two receptions for 17 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.analysis: Ahmed provided the Bears with needed sparks on more than one occasion today, using his speed to initially rip off a 46-yard run on the Bears’ third drive. He later made a slick diving catch for a first down on the Bears’ 10th drive. He can be picked up in 14-team leagues at this time, though he is only a bench stash.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.headline: Bears ruled out Roschon Johnson (ankle) for Week 12 against the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.analysis: Johnson will be replaced by Salvon Ahmed as the Bears’ No. 3 running back. Ahmed does not need to be rostered in 12-team formats, with D’Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai splitting reps.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.headline: Kyle Monangai rushed eight times for 18 yards in the Bears’ Week 11 win over the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.analysis: Monangai played for the first time since suffering a turf toe injury in Week 4, getting 17 snaps on the day. He had five less carries and nine less snaps than D’Andre Swift as Salvon Ahmed also got involved with six carries for 33 yards. Monangai’s first snap was to run a route on third-and-long on the Bears’ first possession while he started in the backfield on the second drive. The 24-year-old had no receptions and just one red zone carry on the day, though his snap share and touch split with Swift was at pre-injury levels. Fantasy managers should anticipate less Ahmed usage in future weeks; Monangai should be in the RB4 ranks for Week 12 against the Lions.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.headline: Bears signed RB Salvon Ahmed to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.analysis: Ahmed was one of the final cuts of camp, but the 27-year-old will provide an extra body for the Bears and could be active on gamedays depending on the health of the tailbacks ahead of the other Chicago options.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.headline: Bears released RB Salvon Ahmed.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.analysis: Ahmed missed all of 2025 with an ankle injury. He joined the Bears in May, but did not make the team. The Bears also released TE Stephen Carlson, DL Marcus Davenport, OL Wesley French, DL James Lynch, WR Scotty Miller, LB Jon Rhattigan and LB Jack Sanborn. The Bears waived WR Maurice Alexander, OL Kiran Amegadjie, OL Caden Barnett, LB Antonio Grier, OL Kyle Hergel, TE Qadir Ismail, DB Anthony Johnson, WR Omari Kelly, OL Jaren Kump, DL Jeremiah Martin, LB Wayne Matthews III, QB Miller Moss, OL Mason Murphy, DB Deantre Prince, WR JP Richardson, DB Marlen Sewell, DB Terell Smith and DB William Wright. The Bears waived DB Beanie Bishop, LB Ruben Hyppolite II and DB Dontae Manning with injury designations. The Bears placed RB Brittain Brown, LB Tony Fields, DB Jaylon Jones and WR Ray-Ray McCloud III on injured reserve and activated P Tory Taylor.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.headline: Bears signed RB Salvon Ahmed.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.analysis: Ahmed suffered a gruesome ankle injury on a hip-drop tackle in training camp prior to the start of last season. He missed all of 2025 and has not seen an NFL field since 2023. Starting his career with the Dolphins, Ahmed hopped around the Broncos and Colts rosters the last two seasons and will now look to make the Bears roster coming off a major ankle injury.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.headline: The Athletic’s James Boyd reports, Colts RB Salvon Ahmed “sustained a season-ending ankle injury after being hip-drop tackled in practice.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.analysis: It’s a brutal development for the 26-year-old running back. Ahmed is scheduled to enter free agency next offseason.
