Hopefully, his rehab goes well and the Colts extend his contract. The team correspondingly signed undrafted free agent rookie RB Nate Noel.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.headline: Colts RB Salvon Ahmed (leg/ankle) was carted off the field during Sunday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.analysis: The now-banned hip-drop tackle was the culprit here. Colts safety Trey Washington reportedly deployed the method on a play that resulted in Ahmed screaming and remaining down for several minutes after the play. The veteran running back was given an air cast before being carted off the field on a stretcher, but it sounds like he’ll be at risk of missing most, if not all, of the season once we learn the details of his injury. Head coach Shane Steichen said after practice that it was a mistake by Washington, a rookie out of Mississippi who is trying to make the team as a UDFA, but it’s a stark reminder of why the league pushed to and ultimately banned the tackle after the 2023 season. Ahmed joined the Colts last October and was battling for a spot on the 53-man roster in camp. Ahmed was reportedly taken to the hospital for X-rays . We’ll be sure to provide any updates as they are announced.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.headline: Colts RB Trey Sermon has a knee injury.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.analysis: Sermon banged up the knee in Week 6’s win over the Titans. With Jonathan Taylor (ankle) likely sidelined for another week, Tyler Goodson could be the team’s default lead back this week against the Dolphins. Goodson in Week 6 had 51 yards on eight rushes and functioned as the team’s primary pass-catching back. The Colts signed RB Salvon Ahmed as backfield depth in case Sermon is out against Miami.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.headline: Broncos signed RB Salvon Ahmed, formerly of the Dolphins, to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/salvon-ahm.analysis: The Broncos added Ahmed after Tyler Badie went down in Sunday’s win over the Jets. Playing four seasons with the Dolphins, Ahmed has 163 carries for 593 yards and five touchdowns, adding 40 catches for 274 yards and a score. He will be depth for the Broncos, who have not found much consistent production from their running back room this season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.headline: Kyle Monangai rushed eight times for 15 yards and two touchdowns in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions, adding one reception for 14 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.analysis: Monangai ran inefficiently this week, but that did not stop him from bullying his way into the end zone for a pair of short touchdowns. The burly back may still be rounding into form after his lengthy turf toe-related absence, but he remains a featured player in the Bears’ elite offense. Monangai is an RB2/FLEX against the Jaguars next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.headline: Kyle Monangai rushed eight times for 18 yards in the Bears’ Week 11 win over the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.analysis: Monangai played for the first time since suffering a turf toe injury in Week 4, getting 17 snaps on the day. He had five less carries and nine less snaps than D’Andre Swift as Salvon Ahmed also got involved with six carries for 33 yards. Monangai’s first snap was to run a route on third-and-long on the Bears’ first possession while he started in the backfield on the second drive. The 24-year-old had no receptions and just one red zone carry on the day, though his snap share and touch split with Swift was at pre-injury levels. Fantasy managers should anticipate less Ahmed usage in future weeks; Monangai should be in the RB4 ranks for Week 12 against the Lions.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.headline: Kyle Monangai (toe) is not on Chicago’s final Week 11 injury report.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.analysis: He’ll return to FLEX plausibility as the Bears take on the Saints in a game where a crockpotting run-heavy attack is certainly in the range of possibilities. Monangai has not played since Week 4, but has fully recovered from a turf toe injury and practiced in full all three days this week. He shouldn’t have any limitations.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.headline: Kyle Monangai (toe) is practicing in full for Week 11 against the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.analysis: Monangai has been out since Week 4 because of the toe issue. He returned to practice late last week but wasn’t ready to suit up after just one session. A full practice today all but guarantee he will be on the field this week. Monangai was splitting work with D’Andre Swift before suffering the toe injury. We suspect his role will be scaled back in his return to action, keeping him in the RB3 ranks despite the good matchup.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.headline: ESPN’s Courtney Cronin reports Kyle Monangai is back at practice and “on track” for Week 11.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.analysis: Monangai has missed the previous five games while dealing with thumb and toe injuries, with the team’s Week 10 bye appearing to have provided enough time for the electric youngster to return following five missed games. He should be expected to step back into a strict timeshare with D’Andre Swift after earning 31 percent to 54 percent of the team’s offensive snaps through the first four weeks of the 2026 season. Monangai returns to a viable Flex profile and downgrades Swift from weekly RB1 status to a borderline RB2.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.headline: Bears declared QB Case Keenum, CB Malik Muhammad, RB Kyle Monangai, LB Keyshaun Elliott and DT Jayden Loving inactive for Week 9 against the Buccaneers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.analysis: Monangai will miss one more week with the expectation being that the 24-year-old tailback will be good to go after the bye in Week 10. Keenum will be the emergency third quarterback.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) will not play in Week 9 against the Bucs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.analysis: Per Rapoport, Monangai is expected to return after Chicago’s Week 10 bye. Monangai has been out since Week 4. He finally returned to practice earlier this week, but it was for a single, limited session on Friday. He should be back in a 1B role when the Bears take on the Saints in two weeks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.headline: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) returned to practice Friday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.analysis: The Bears are calling the tailback questionable for Week 9 against the Buccaneers. It’s the first time that Monangai has been able to practice picking up the injury a month ago against the Jets. It seems extremely unlikely that the 24-year-old will be able to play against Tampa Bay on Sunday night, but he appears to be on track to return after the Week 10 bye for the final stretch. Malik Muhammed and Tyrique Stevenson are also questionable for the Sunday Night showdown.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.headline: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) did not participate in Thursday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.analysis: It’s back-to-back missed practices for the 24-year-old ahead of Week 9’s contest against the Buccaneers. It seems more than likely that Monangai comes back for Week 10 after the bye, but if he can get a full session in, there’s a chance he rolls against Tampa Bay come Sunday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.headline: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) did not practice in Wednesday’s walkthrough.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-monan.analysis: Monangai was an estimated DNP on Wednesday, still not practicing in any capacity since Week 4. He has missed four consecutive games and is trending to miss a fifth one in Week 9 against the Buccaneers. In any injury taking this long for a return, a full practice is the best indicator of a return but the Bears may just wait until after their Week 10 bye to bring Monangai back. D’Andre Swift is in line for a workhorse game once again.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.headline: D’Andre Swift rushed nine times for 65 yards and one touchdown in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions, adding seven receptions for 97 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.analysis: Swift was extremely efficient on his touches against the Lions, which was good because the Bears got Kyle Monangai and Salvon Ahmed going in this one as well. Swift had two 30-plus-yard gains today. His first was a catch in the flats, which he took down the right sideline after juking two Lions defenders. The second was a clean touchdown run in which he faked right before cutting back to the left and outrunning the defense. He regularly operated as a needed checkdown option for Caleb Williams today. Swift is a borderline RB1/2 against the Jaguars next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.headline: D’Andre Swift rushed 13 times for 51 yards and a fumble in the Bears’ Week 11 win over the Saints, adding two receptions for eight yards and a touchdown.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.analysis: Swift got the first three touches of the game for the Bears, operating as the lead back with Kyle Monangai back. His snaps took a dip, especially after a fourth quarter fumble. A shovel pass from Caleb Williams for a receiving score in the first half saved his fantasy production as Bears drives stalled frequently against the Saints. The good news is that Swift is still the lead back, though Monangai’s return will eat into his workload. Swift belongs in the fantasy RB2 ranks for a Week 12 Thanksgiving matchup against the Lions.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.headline: D’Andre Swift rushed 12 times for 31 yards in the Bears’ Week 9 win over the Buccaneers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.analysis: Swift didn’t catch his lone target in a bust of a contest for the veteran tailback. He had a long gain of just six yards, and was nearly outrun by Salvon Ahmed who finished with 25 yards on the ground. Yes, that Salvon Ahmed. It’s a disappointing — but not terribly surprising — follow-up to the three touchdowns he had Monday night in Week 8, but this is what Swift has done throughout his career. He’ll be a RB2 for Week 11 against the Saints after the Bears’ enjoy their bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.headline: D’Andre Swift rushed 27 times for 69 yards and three touchdowns in the Bears’ Week 8 win over the Seahawks, adding 10 yards on two receptions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.analysis: Swift managers were sweating early as he alternated drives with Roschon Johnson. Those worries were swiftly erased as the veteran lead back played almost the entirety of the second half, scoring all three of his short yardage touchdowns after the break. The three trips to paint marked his second game with three touchdowns through the first eight weeks, now the only player in the league with multiple three-touchdown games. Swift will be a matchup-based RB2 when the Bears host the Buccaneers in Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.headline: D’Andre Swift rushed 22 times for 78 yards and a touchdown in the Bears’ Week 7 win over the Patriots, adding 12 yards on four receptions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.analysis: Swift shook off an early injury scare when he took a helmet directly to his knee to earn a season-high 26 opportunities in the absence of Kyle Monangai. This game had an entirely different feel than the previous game played without Monangai, during which Roschon Johnson was much more involved in a game the Bears held a 31-7 lead in the fourth quarter. The back-and-forth nature of Week 7 kept Swift on the field for more of the game, allowing him to return a legitimate RB1 performance on the backs of elite volume. Monangai could return as early as Week 8 considering the Bears now have 10 days until they play the Seahawks on Monday Night Football, potentially sending Swift back into the RB2 range in fantasy circles.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.headline: Bears ruled out Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) for Week 7 against the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.analysis: Monangai will miss his third game in a row this week. Exactly two weeks ago, ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reported that Monangai’s turf toe injury would be an issue for 1-2 weeks. Technically, his statement remains accurate. This week’s Thursday Night Football game complicates things. If the Bears thought Monangai would miss four games, they likely would have put him on injured reserve, so he should, theoretically, be able to play in Week 8 against the Seahawks. Of course, nothing is guaranteed, and for those wondering, the Bears go on bye in Week 10. D’Andre Swift and Roschon Johnson have been splitting touches with Monangai sidelined. We do not yet know if Johnson will be punished for last week’s fumble though.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.headline: D’Andre Swift had 16 rushes for 44 yards and two touchdowns in the Bears’ Week 6 win against the Falcons, adding four catches for 26 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.analysis: Swift again dominated backfield touches for Chicago with Kyle Monangai sidelined with injuries to his toe and hand. Roschon Johnson had 13 carries, with most of those coming after the Bears had raced out to a big lead (before that lead dwindled in the fourth quarter). Both of Swift’s touchdowns came inside the ten yard line. Swift should be locked in for at least 15 touches in Week 7 against the Patriots if Monangai remains sidelined. His involvement in the pass game provides a nice weekly PPR floor.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.headline: Bears ruled out Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) for Week 6 against the Falcons.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.analysis: Bears coach Ben Johnson said Monangai is “trending in the right direction,” but remains week-to-week. D’Andre Swift should handle a sizable workload with Monangai sidelined. Roschon Johnson may be able to catch a few passes, but he makes for a shaky FLEX bet. Monangai should be stashed safely on fantasy football benches.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.headline: D’Andre Swift rushed nine times for 43 yards and a touchdown in the Bears’ Week 5 loss to the Packers, adding four receptions for 30 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.analysis: Swift was the only Bear to find the end zone in a throwaway performance where Tyson Bagent was benched for the fourth quarter. It was still a disappointing statline with Kyle Monangai (toe) on the shelf, but there just wasn’t much Swift could do with Bagent failing to threaten the Packers’ defense and the Bears’ D struggling mightily. Swift also lost a ton of passing-game work and targets to fill-in No. 2 RB Roschon Johnson. That’s a potentially disturbing development heading into Week 6 against the Falcons, with or without Monangai in the lineup. Thankfully, Caleb Williams (hamstring) should be back, shoring up Swift’s value in the RB10-14 range.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.headline: D’Andre Swift (hip/knee) is not on Chicago’s final Week 5 injury report.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dandre-swi.analysis: Despite an early-week DNP, Swift heads into the week in arguably a better position than he started it. We’re not sure how much workload he’ll handle with Kyle Monangai (foot) out, but it will certainly be a large majority of what the Bears do. Roschon Johnson figures to handle whatever Swift can’t, but isn’t a priority free agency pickup so much as a stash at this point.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.headline: Saquon Barkley is questionable to return in Week 12 against the Cowboys with a stinger.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.analysis: Barkley has struggled with just seven yards on five attempts, and was seen grimacing on the sideline before exiting the contest. With Barkley unavailable, Will Shipley will likely see the majority of touches.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.headline: Saquon Barkley (neck, illness) practiced in full Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.analysis: Barkley is good to go for Thanksgiving Day against the Cowboys. He left last week’s win over the Steelers with a stinger in the second half but seems OK a few days later. On Thursday he’ll face off against a Dallas defense allowing the second highest rate of fantasy points per touch to running backs, along with the league’s highest rush yards over expected per attempt. Barkley should be considered a locked-in top-12 option.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.headline: Saquon Barkley (neck/illness) practiced in full on Tuesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.analysis: It’s an upgrade over his limited session on Monday. Barkley told reporters after Sunday’s game that he doesn’t think he’ll ever get to 100 percent again for the rest of the season, saying “That’s not how football works.” But it seems like he’s at least “football healthy” enough to go against the Cowboys on Thanksgiving.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.headline: Saquon Barkley (neck/illness) was limited in Monday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.analysis: We described Barkley as leaving the game in the fourth quarter with what “appeared to be a left arm” injury in Sunday’s blurb, it sounds like it may have been a stinger based on the neck listing. A limited (estimated) session is better than a DNP, but Tuesday’s report will loom large for Barkley’s chances of playing against the Cowboys on Thursday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.headline: Saquon Barkley had 17 rushes for 75 yards and a touchdown in the Eagles’ Week 11 win against the Steelers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.analysis: Barkley broke a few decent runs in the first half and was mostly bottled up in the second half against a tough Pittsburgh rush defense. He left the game in the fourth quarter with what appeared to be a left arm injury, though it’s unclear if the injury was serious. Barkley, who ran a route on 10 of 28 drop backs, did not see a target. With Joe Milton at QB, Barkley is nothing more than a touchdown-dependent RB2 going forward, including next week against the Cowboys.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.headline: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) is practicing in full for Week 11 against the Steelers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.analysis: Barkley is no longer listed with a back injury, and is practicing in full post-bye. Both factors are extremely encouraging. The veteran running back is an RB1 against the Steelers this week, likely with an uptick in touches compared to the 13-carry workload he handled in Week 9 against the Giants.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.headline: Saquon Barkley rushed 13 times for 22 yards and a touchdown in the Eagles’ Week 9 loss to the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.analysis: It was a horribly inefficient day for the Eagles’ superstar back, but there was not a whole lot he could do with the Giants understandably not respecting the “threat” presented by No. 3 Philly quarterback Joe Milton. Barkley at least saved face with his three-yard scoring plunge in the first quarter. Having his snaps and touches rationed for this injury-ruined and tanking team, Barkley will probably have a hard time getting back into the RB1 ranks when Philly comes off bye in Week 11 against the Steelers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.headline: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) is not on the final injury report for Week 9 against the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.analysis: Barkley will again play through his hamstring and back injuries. Touchdowns have helped offset Barkley’s moderate yardage totals, and the offense will now be led by Joe Milton. Barkley’s role and talent keep him in the high-end RB2 tier, though an apex outcome is perhaps unlikely, given the state of the Eagles’ offense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.headline: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) resumed practicing on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.analysis: Barkley is again on track to play through his injuries on game day. The Eagles’ offensive centerpiece totaled 54 scrimmage yards, one catch and one touchdown in the Eagles’ Week 8 loss to the Commanders. He may have trouble solidifying a spot in the RB1 tier, given the state of the Eagles’ offense, but he remains a high-end RB2 at worst, based on talent and usage.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.headline: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) was not seen at the start of Wednesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/saquon-bar.analysis: Barkley played through the pair of injuries last week, turning 13 carries into 30 yards and a score. While this could just be maintenance for a banged-up veteran, the Eagles are waving the white flag on 2026 by starting Joe Milton at quarterback. If they’re worried about making Barkley’s injuries worse, the team may simply shut him down for the year at some point. Elijah Mitchell is the next man up for Philly if Barkley doesn’t play in Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Caleb WIlliams told reporters that he was “fine” after undergoing X-rays following the Week 12 win over the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Williams said that he thought there was just a bruise on his abdomen after taking a fall. The signal-caller will get a mini-bye before the Bears take on the Jaguars in Week 13, and should be good to go for that contest.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Caleb Williams completed 30-of-44 passes for 345 yards and two touchdowns in the Bears’ 39-35, Week 12 win over the Lions, adding three rushes for 15 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: The Bears trailed 24-35 when they got the ball back with a little over eight minutes remaining in the game. Williams then activated “Iceman” mode, linking up with Luther Burden and Rome Odunze (twice) for 71 yards, one passing touchdown and a successful QB keeper on the two-point conversion. A Lions interception and consecutive turnovers on downs for both teams resulted in the Bears getting the ball back with just over two minutes remaining in the game. Aided by a 15-yard facemask penalty on the Lions, Williams again led the offense down the field before firing a perfectly placed ball to Rome Odunze in the back-right corner of the end zone for a six-yard score, powering the Bears to a 39-35 fourth-quarter comeback. The Chicago Tribune’s Brad Biggs reports that although Williams participated in all post-game celebration activities, he was taken for an X-ray afterward. We await an update. Stay tuned.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Caleb Williams completed 15-of-23 passes for 181 yards, two touchdowns, and an interception in the Bears’ 21-13, Week 11 win over the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: The Bears offense had its usual explosiveness, but struggled to finish drives. Williams’ mobility was on full display, using his legs to buy time and find receivers while adding 13 rushing yards before a pair of end-of-game kneels. He lofted up a fourth down end zone target to Kalif Raymond that was broken up in the first quarter and threw an interception in the second quarter. The drives that did end in touchdowns for the Bears in the first half came on a Williams shovel pass to D’Andre Swift and a toss to Colston Loveland in the flat he ran in for the score. Williams had completions of over 10 yards to five different receivers as he continued to push the ball downfield. His high-risk, high-reward style of play lends it self to splash plays to boost fantasy production. Williams will be in the low-end QB1 ranks for a Thanksgiving day matchup against the Lions.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Caleb Williams completed 22-of-37 passes for 279 yards with two touchdowns and four interceptions in the Bears’ 27-24, Week 9 win over the Buccaneers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: An absolutely bizarre football game. Williams was brilliant on the first two drives with two touchdowns. After that, things got weird at best and disastrous at worst. He threw interceptions on back-to-back throws in the second quarter, and threw two more picks for his first career four-INT game. Kudos to the Bucs for generating the pressure necessary to create those picks — this is back-to-back four interception games for the Tampa Bay defense — but three of the four interceptions were egregious throws. He was able to get the job done at the end of the night, hitting Colston Loveland on a blown coverage for a 38-yard gain that set up the game-winning field goal. He’ll get a week to review the tape on bye before taking on the Saints in Week 11.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Caleb Williams completed 24-of-34 passes for 247 yards and one touchdown in the Bears’ 34-17, Week 8 win over the Seahawks, adding one yard on two carries.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Williams marched the Bears down the field for a 17-play opening possession touchdown, snapping a 26-game streak in which the Seahawks kept opponents out of the end zone on first possessions in the process. The two teams traded defensive stops for much of the remainder of the first half before the Bears opened the flood gates after the break, vaulting to a 6-2 record and now just half a game behind the Vikings for the lead in the NFC North. Williams’ ball placement was impeccable in this one, the most notable of which came just after the half on three absolute dimes to Rome Odunze for chunk gains. Two surging teams meet in Week 9 when the Bears host the pass-funnel Buccaneers on Sunday Night Football, where Williams will remain a back end QB1.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Caleb Williams completed 22-of-33 passes for 308 yards and two touchdowns in the Bears’ 30-24, Week 7 win over the Patriots, adding 18 yards on five carries.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: The enigmatic signal caller also took three sacks, the last of which almost placed the Bears in position to hand the keys to victory to the Patriots. Ben Johnson called a pass play on third-and-five with under two minutes to play in Patriots territory, placing another nod of support toward his franchise quarterback. Things turned dire when Williams took a sack that appeared to take the Bears out of field goal range in a six-point game, with veteran kicker Cairo Santos hitting a career-long 58-yard field goal to dispel the worries. That sequence of two plays displayed Johnson’s unrelenting trust in his players considering the 58-yard field goal was not only the longest of Santos’ 12-year career, but the third longest field goal in Soldier Field history. Either way, Williams and the Bears escaped with the victory and move to 5-2, now 1.5-games behind the Vikings for the division lead in the most competitive division in football. The Bears get a mini-bye ahead of a Week 8 meeting with the Seahawks on Monday Night Football, where Williams will remain a back-end QB1 in fantasy.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Caleb Williams completed 30-of-36 attempts for 305 yards and a touchdown in the Bears’ Week 6 win against the Falcons, adding four rushes for three yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Williams was all the way back in this one, returning to action after three weeks on the sideline recovering from a hamstring injury. His only real miss of the day came on a ten yard throw to Colston Loveland that should have been an easy touchdown. Williams tormented the pass-funnel Atlanta defense with middle-of-the-field throws, along with typical out-of-structure passes to the sideline. It was an impressive outing against a Falcons defense giving up the league’s fifth lowest drop back success rate. Williams should remain in lineups in Week 7 against the Patriots.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Caleb Williams (hamstring) is active for Week 6 against the Falcons.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Williams will make his return to the starting lineup after being sidelined for a few weeks with a hamstring injury while the Bears declared RB Kyle Monangai, CB Tyrique Stevenson, LB T.J. Edwards, LB Keyshaun Elliott, OL Jordan McFadden, DL Jayden Loving, and QB Case Keenum inactive against Atlanta. Monongai’s absence should translate into another big workload for D’Andre Swift, facing a tough Falcons rush defense. Meanwhile, Tyson Bagent will serve as Williams’ backup.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Caleb Williams (hamstring) will start in Week 6 against the Falcons.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: This was expected to be the case but is now confirmed by sources close to the team. Williams returns after missing the previous three games as the Bears look to claw their way back into contention in a crowded NFC North division. Consider it a sizable boost for all Chicago pass catchers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Caleb Williams (hamstring) posted a video to social media indicating he will play in Week 6 against the Falcons.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Normally, social media posts don’t count for much. However, earlier today, Bears coach Ben Johnson said that the Bears should have more clarity on Williams’ status by the end of the day, after the medical team put Williams through “the final stress tests” in his return-to-play program. We are inferring that Williams’ social media post suggests he passed the final medical testing, though we have not officially received word that this is indeed the case. For now, we tentatively expect Williams to play on Sunday. He can be treated as a mid-to-low QB1.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahdae-wal.headline: Jahdae Walker caught 0-of-1 targets in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahdae-wal.analysis: Walker did not do himself any favors in this one. He got open on the Bears’ 10th drive, and Caleb Williams heaved a well-placed, desperate pass his way while evading pressure way downfield. Walker bobbled it, giving Lions S Kerby Joseph the chance to punch the ball out of his possession, resulting in a turnover on downs. Walker does not need to be rostered in 12-team leagues.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahdae-wal.headline: The Athletic’s Kevin Fishbain believes the “expectation” is that Kalif Raymond will be the team’s No. 3 receiver.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahdae-wal.analysis: Jahdae Walker could position himself as the No. 3 with a second-year jump, and third-round pick Zavion Thomas is also in the mix. This room will probably split the snaps enough to make them unappealing from a fantasy perspective, but it’s possible someone emerges as a WR4-type.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahdae-wal.headline: Jahdae Walker caught 2-of-3 targets for 36 yards and a touchdown in the Bears’ Week 18 loss to the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahdae-wal.analysis: Walker continued to operate as the team’s WR3 in the absence of Rome Odunze, this time cashing in on a 25-yard touchdown to start the fourth quarter for the team’s first points of the game. he is likely to return to a modest role once Odunze returns to the game-day roster, which should occur when the team hosts the Packers in the Wild Card round next weekend.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahdae-wal.headline: Jahdae Walker caught 2-of-3 targets for 15 yards and a touchdown in the Bears’ Week 16 win over the Packers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jahdae-wal.analysis: Walker, a UDFA out of Texas A&M, found himself in an increased role on Saturday with Rome Odunze and Luther Burden both sidelined. Walker got on the board with his first career catch on the Bears’ opening drive, and scored his first touchdown on a six-yard pass near the end of regulation to tie the game at 16-16. Saturday’s performance was a nice outing for the rookie UDFA, but he won’t have any fantasy value heading into Week 17 against the 49ers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.headline: Kalif Raymond caught 3-of-5 targets for 20 yards in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.analysis: Raymond chipped in as needed in the Bears’ win. On his best play, he snagged a play-action pass and ran upfield for a first down on the Bears’ first drive. Raymond does not need to be rostered in 12-team leagues.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.headline: Kalif Raymond caught 1-of-4 targets for 14 yards in the Bears’ Week 11 win over the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.analysis: Raymond was targeted four times, including an incomplete end zone target on fourth down in the first half. He caught one of his targets for 14 total yards, though he had the second-most wide receiver snaps on the team. Raymond is still involved as the starting outside receiver opposite Rome Odunze but has boom-or-bust WR5 viability at best heading into Week 12

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.headline: Kalif Raymond caught 4-of-7 targets for 32 yards in the Bears’ Week 9 win over the Buccaneers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.analysis: Raymond had a quiet day, but made a huge 13-yard catch on the final drive that ended with a Cairo Santos’ game-winning field goal. Luther Burden exited the game with a head injury late, and if Burden can’t go in Week 11 after the bye, Raymond will be an intriguing dart throw for that contest. If Burden can go, he’s tough to trust in redraft formats.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.headline: Kalif Raymond caught 2-of-3 targets for 14 yards in the Bears’ Week 8 win over the Seahawks, adding 39 yards on one carry.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.analysis: Raymond’s lone “carry” came on a third-and-long in the fourth quarter in a three-point game, with the play ruled a rush attempt following a slightly backwards toss on a quick swing pass to the perimeter. Raymond did the rest as he turned on the jets for a 39-yard gain to the five, which D’Andre Swift would punch in for the second of his three rushing scores on the evening. Raymond remains unlikely to match his early-season exploits but can be stashed in case of injury to Luther Burden, Rome Odunze, or Colston Loveland.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.headline: Kalif Raymond caught both of his targets for 18 yards in the Bears’ Week 6 win against the Falcons.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.analysis: Raymond ran a pass route on 18 of the Bears’ 45 drop backs and didn’t see a target until the second half. He has been mostly phased out of the team’s passing offense since profiling as Chicago’s de facto WR1 over the first couple games of the season. Raymond, who has just 30 receiving yards over his past three games, can be left on the waiver wire ahead of Week 7.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.headline: Kalif Raymond caught 3-of-4 targets for six yards in the Bears’ Week 5 loss to the Packers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.analysis: Raymond’s fast start to the season has now been erased to the tune of just five catches for 12 yards over the past two weeks. Even with Caleb Williams (hamstring) looking likely to return for Week 6 against the Falcons, Raymond’s brief moment in the 2026 fantasy sun has come and gone.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.headline: Kalif Raymond caught 6-of-7 targets for 90 yards and a touchdown in the Bears’ Week 3 win over the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.analysis: Raymond has now led the Bears in receiving in two of the team’s first three games, with Week 3 his best performance yet on the back of a 41-yard touchdown through busted coverage. It isn’t likely the career role player will lead the team in receiving throughout the season, but the early returns on investment must have fantasy managers ecstatic for those that either drafted him in the final round or scooped him off the wire following Week 1.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.headline: Kalif Raymond caught 5-of-5 targets for 40 yards in the Bears’ Week 2 loss to the Vikings.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.analysis: For whatever reason, Raymond again lead the Bears’ receiver corps in production, though Luther Burden did out-target him on fewer snaps. Cold comfort. Although Raymond out-snapped Burden, he was on the field 16 fewer plays than Rome Odunze. Pro Football Focus’ Nathan Jahnke charted Raymond as seeing more time in “12" personnel than his sophomore teammate. We would like to say this is bound to change going forward, but coach Ben Johnson had no problem featuring veteran Olamide Zaccheaus in 2025. Raymond is struggling to create WR4 value of his own, but he is certainly hampering Burden and Odunze’s production ahead of Week 3 against the Eagles.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.headline: Kalif Raymond caught 8-of-9 targets for 89 yards in the Bears’ Week 1 win against the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.analysis: Raymond, who ran a route on 23 of 40 Caleb Williams drop backs, led the Bears in targets, catches, and receiving yards, while Colston Loveland went catchless and Luther Burden was an afterthought. Raymond’s route participation suggests he’ll be a rotational player in the run-first Chicago offense. That should make him a risky option in any sort of fantasy league. Even so, it’s clear Raymond has taken something similar to the D.J. Moore role and could be useful in fantasy this year.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.headline: The Chicago Tribune’s Sean Hammond reports that Bears WR Rome Odunze exited practice early on Thursday after suffering an apparent leg injury.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kalif-raym.analysis: Per Hammond, Odunze “came up hobbling during an install period at the start of practice,” with what appeared to be a right leg injury. Apparently, Odunze “wasn’t overly concerned” and tried to continue practicing, but Bears trainers removed him from the field. That last bit is encouraging. Hopefully, Odunze’s Week 1 availability has not been jeopardized. Bears TE Colston Loveland and WR Luther Burden would benefit if Odunze cannot play. Odunze is backed up by WR Kalif Raymond.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-roush/.headline: Sam Roush caught 5-of-5 targets for 31 yards in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-roush/.analysis: Roush’s role increased after Colston Loveland suffered a worrying knee injury early in the game. The rookie tight end showed off his physicality by running over a would-be tackler on an 11-yard gain on the Bears’ seventh drive. Backup TE Stephen Carlson caught 2-of-4 targets for 30 yards as well. Roush could be a TE1/2 against the Jaguars next week if Loveland is sidelined.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-roush/.headline: Colston Loveland was ruled out in Week 12 against the Lions after suffering a knee injury.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-roush/.analysis: This is concerning. A Lions defender tumbled into Loveland’s lower leg left while the Bears’ tight end was blocking on a run play. After a brief trip to the trainer’s table, he was taken to the locker room for further evaluation. It took only 15 minutes for the team to rule him out. Before exiting, Loveland caught 1-of-1 targets for five yards and lost one fumble. On his lone catch, a Lions defender tied up his legs while a second defender ran in and punched the ball out of his possession. Since they are playing on Thanksgiving, the Bears have a few extra rest days before their Week 13 game against the Jaguars. We should find out whether Loveland has a chance to play next week in the next day or so. Rookie TE Sam Roush is now the Bears’ top tight end.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-roush/.headline: Bears coach Ben Johnson said Cole Kmet (knee) will miss the rest of the season.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-roush/.analysis: Unfortunately it’s not much of a surprise based on the reporting or the carting. Sam Roush will take over as Chicago’s TE2 and likely have fringe TE2 value. Kmet will be in the final year of his four-year, $50 million extension in 2027. The 28-year-old will be a potential cap casualty with a $15.425 million cap figure and $10 million in savings on release without getting into post-June 1 cap machinations.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-roush/.headline: Bears signed TE Sam Roush to a four-year, $7.35 million contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-roush/.analysis: The Bears now have all of their rookies under contract with the signing of Roush, mere weeks before the start of training camp. The selection of another tight end in the third round turned heads during the draft, but another athletic and well-rounded option at the position gives head coach Ben Johnson further flexibility to run higher rates of 12 and 13-personnel in the coming year. Roush brings a tantalizing athletic profile to the professional ranks, although he likely needs to improve his blocking abilities to carve out a significant role behind Colston Loveland and Cole Kmet during his rookie campaign.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-roush/.headline: Bears selected Stanford TE Sam Roush with the No. 69 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-roush/.analysis: A true tight end’s tight end, Roush (6’6/267), does a little bit of everything without one elite trait. He peaked at 49 catches for 545 yards and two scores as a senior. Those two scores make up half of his collegiate touchdowns. The low scoring total could, in part, be explained by Roush’s struggles on contested targets, of which he secured just 47 percent. Roush isn’t a mauling blocker, but he handled his business in the trenches at Stanford and his massive frame will make the NFL transition a bit easier. His elite athletic measurable — highlighted by a 4.7 40 — will also make the leap to pro completion more manageable. Roush simply needs to play to his size more as a blocker and at the catch point. He will begin his career behind Cole Kmet and Colston Loveland. Roush won’t be a threat to Loveland, but he could take on Kmet’s role as a blocker and TE2 in Chicago after 2026.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-roush/.headline: Stanford signed 2022 four-star TE Sam Roush.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-roush/.analysis: Roush (6'5"/240) will also enroll early with the Cardinals. It’s a very nice get, as Roush is the 11th ranked TE in the class, and the eighth ranked player out of Tennessee. Roush projects as an excellent pass catcher, and has NFL potential. He’s the fifth highest rated player in Stanford’s current No. 1 PAC-12 class.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden caught 3-of-7 targets for 44 yards in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden’s impact on the game was bigger than it was in the box score. He went in motion and helped block on the interior for Kyle Monangai’s first rushing touchdown. Aside from that, Burden generated a 25-yard gain on a slick post route and a 15-yard gain that helped set up Rome Odunze’s 41-yard score. Burden nearly hauled in a 46-yard pass on the Bears’ eighth drive, but Caleb Williams overthrew him. Burden was also flagged for offensive pass interference for what should have been considered justifiable handfighting. Burden took an end around for just one yard. Lions S Kerby Joseph delivered a helmet-to-helmet hit on the play, but was not flagged for it. Burden will be a WR2 against the Jaguars in Week 13.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden caught 2-of-3 targets for 10 yards in the Bears’ Week 11 win over the Saints, adding one carry for three yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden had little involvement in a low-volume passing day for the Bears. He saw three of Caleb Williams’ 23 passing attempts on a day where no Bears pass-catcher had more than four targets. Rookie Zavion Thomas saw the splash plays on the day as Burden had short-yardage usage to pick up quick first downs out of the slot. The first half game script did not favor Burden, but given his elite production in recent weeks, he is back in the low-end WR2 ranks for a Thanksgiving day game against the Lions.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Luther Burden III has cleared the NFL’s concussion protocol.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden had the Bears’ bye week to recover from the head injury, and it looks like he’ll be a full go for Week 11 against the Saints — barring a setback, of course. Burden has been an elite producer of late, piling up 283 receiving yards over his past three outings while being targeted on a strong 30 percent of his pass routes. Burden over that span has averaged nearly 11 yards after the catch per reception, the third highest mark in the NFL.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden left Week 9’s game against the Buccaneers with an apparent injury. He finished with 7 catches for 97 yards and a touchdown before exiting.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden fumbled and set up Tampa Bay’s tying score in the fourth quarter after a shot that could have easily been a helmet-to-helmet penalty. The 22-year-old did most of his damage on a 58-yard score that gave Chicago a 14-0 lead. Burden will assuredly undergo concussion testing, but it’s worth noting the Bears don’t play again until Week 11 against the Lions because of a bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden caught 7-of-9 targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in the Bears’ Week 8 win over the Seahawks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden’s opening drive score was the first touchdown surrendered by the Seahawks on an opening possession in the previous 26 games, finishing tied with tight end Colston Loveland for the team lead in targets while catching the only passing score from quarterback Caleb Williams. He continues to operate as the team’s top option through the air in a role that is most malleable, which can either be concentrated on the short areas against zone or extended in the vertical against man. Burden is a WR2 in a pass-funnel matchup against the Buccaneers in Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden caught all four targets for 130 yards and a touchdown in the Bears’ Week 7 win over the Patriots, adding seven yards on one carry.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden erupted on the scene with a 58-yard, catch-and-run reception on a crosser in the first quarter to set up a four-yard score for D’Andre Swift. He would tack on another 24 yards and his touchdown late in the second quarter to push him over the century mark in yards on an improbable touchdown reception, taking a quick screen to the house on third-and-17 with only 14 seconds remaining before the break. Burden would largely fall victim to a more reserved offensive stance after the Bears pushed their lead to 13 points on their first possession of the second half, adding just one additional reception in the final 30 minutes of play. That matters not to fantasy managers that had been waiting for a marquee performance from a player they chased up draft boards this summer. Burden appears to be heating up now further removed from the offseason injury he carried into the start of the regular season and can continue to be started as an upside WR2 ahead of a difficult matchup against the Seahawks in Week 8.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden III caught all eight of his targets for 95 yards in the Bears’ Week 6 win against the Falcons.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: With Caleb Williams back from a hamstring injury, Burden led the Bears with eight targets and a season-high 95 yards, mostly on short over-the-middle passes from Williams. Burden’s long play was a 25-yard catch and run. That he ran a route on just 19 of the Bears’ 45 drop backs is something of a concern going forward. With that little route involvement, Burden will have to be hyper efficient if he’s going to be a WR2/3 in fantasy formats. He should remain in lineups next week against the Patriots.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden III caught 4-of-6 targets for 47 yards in the Bears’ Week 5 loss to the Packers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden “led” the Bears in receiving, but the fact that 47 yards was the team’s high-water mark tells you all you need to know about their offensive effectiveness this afternoon. Today was actually the first time in three games without Caleb Williams that Burden finished under 60 yards receiving, but he is still in dire need of his starting quarterback’s return. It appears that will be Week 6 against the Falcons, keeping Burden in the low-end WR2 mix despite his lack of spiked weeks through the season’s first five contests.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden III caught 4-of-6 targets for 63 yards in the Bears’ Week 4 win against the Jets, adding one rush for 11 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: It was a fine outing for Burden after he showed signs of life in Week 3’s win over the Eagles. Burden was second on the team in targets, trailing Rome Odunze’s seven looks from Tyson Bagent. He ran a few more pass routes than Kalif Raymond, who had two grabs for six yards. Chicago operating as a run-first team is going to necessarily limit Burden’s opportunities, but he should suffice as a WR3/4 in the coming weeks. That includes next week against a middling Green Bay secondary.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden caught 7-of-11 targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in the Bears’ Week 3 win over the Eagles, adding seven yards on one carry.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden got the scoring started with a shovel-pass touchdown on the first possession of the game and continued to be the primary engine of the offense on a night the team was led by veteran journeyman Case Keenum. Head coach Ben Johnson handily outmatched his counterpart in Sean Mannion, keeping the offense in rhythm and unpredictable throughout. Burden should continue to improve upon his early-season returns for fantasy managers that chased him up draft boards this offseason, particularly once Caleb Williams returns to the starting roster in a few weeks. In the meantime, treat Burden as an upside WR2 ahead of a Week 4 meeting with the Jets in Chicago.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.headline: Broncos activated Tyler Badie off injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.analysis: Badie is back after missing a month with his thumb ailment. He’ll get some touches behind Jonah Coleman during Friday’s contest against the Steelers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.headline: Tyler Badie (thumb) is questionable for Week 12 against the Steelers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.analysis: Badie could return from injured reserve this week. The Broncos need an RB2 with JK Dobbins suspended for one game, but Badie would not be worth rostering in 12-team leagues, even if he fills that role.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.headline: Broncos designated Tyler Badie (thumb) to return from injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.analysis: His 21-day window opens with a full practice. Seems like perhaps J.K. Dobbins’ suspension has accelerated the timeline on this decision, so Badie may have a chance to be activated for Friday’s game against the Steelers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.headline: Broncos ruled out Tyler Badie (thumb) for Week 7
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.analysis: Badie is likely headed toward a demotion with Jonah Coleman (ankle) inching toward a return. The latter player is questionable to play this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.headline: Jonah Coleman (ankle) practiced in full on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.analysis: Coleman is trending toward returning for the Broncos’ Week 7 game against the Cardinals. His teammate, RB Tyler Badie (thumb), remains sidelined. Coleman makes for a risky start if active, but the Broncos’ coaching staff likes him. He should be rostered in 12-team formats.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.headline: Tyler Badie (thumb) did not practice Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.analysis: Badie was a non-participant in practice with a thumb injury. With Jonah Coleman designated to return from injured reserve, Badie does not need to be rostered for fantasy purposes.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.headline: Tyler Badie had two rushes for seven yards in the Broncos’ Week 4 loss to the 49ers, adding two catches for 32 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.analysis: Badie was again the team’s RB3 behind JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey. Harvey led the backfield with ten catches on ten targets while Dobbins had a team-leading 11 carries. Badie would be somewhat interesting in deeper leagues if Harvey were to miss more time this season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.headline: Tyler Badie had one rush for one yard in the Broncos’ Week 2 win against the Jaguars, adding two catches for 28 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.analysis: Badie saw significant action in this one after JK Dobbins exited the contest with a hamstring injury. RJ Harvey was inactive with his own hamstring issue, leaving Badie in the Harvey role and rookie RB Jonah Coleman as the primary early-down option for OC Davis Webb. If Dobbins and Harvey are sidelined next week against the Rams, Badie would have some usefulness in deeper PPR formats.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.headline: Broncos declared RB Tyler Badie, DT Tyler Onyedim, TE Dallen Bentley, OL Kage Casey, DL Jordan Jackson, and QB Sam Ehlinger inactive for Week 1 against the Chiefs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.analysis: Badie’s inclusion on the Week 1 inactives list means rookie Jonah Coleman gets the nod as the RB3 behind J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey. It remains unlikely Coleman contributes meaningful counting stats in his first professional appearance, but the fact he is now confirmed to be ahead of Badie is meaningful to his longterm upside in what should be one of the top rushing attacks in the league.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.headline: The Denver Post’s Luca Evans believes Tyler Badie and Jaleel McLaughlin are battling for one roster spot in training camp.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-badi.analysis: Badie probably has the edge given his versatility on special teams and third-down work. McLaughlin’s path to a roster spot “looks dicey” per Evans.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rome Odunze caught 6-of-9 targets for 87 yards and two touchdowns in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Caleb Williams and Odunze nearly linked up for a 20-yard touchdown during the Bears’ sixth drive, but the pass was a little too far outside the end zone for Odunze to get his feet down. Williams began looking his way more and more as the game progressed, and things really kicked off partway through the fourth quarter, when Williams hit Odunze on consecutive plays for a 15-yard gain and a 41-yard touchdown. Williams went right back to him for the game-winning score, firing a dart to the Bears’ leaping wide receiver in the back-right corner of the end zone with nine seconds left in the game. Odunze is a WR3/FLEX against the Jaguars in Week 13.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rome Odunze caught 4-of-4 targets for 45 yards in the Bears’ Week 11 win over the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Odunze was involved in the intermediate area for the Bears, making a 19-yard grab on the first drive. He made a 16-yard catch later in the first half, getting tackled inside the five-yard line and setting up a touchdown. His four targets were tied for the most on the team, with Caleb Williams only attempting 23 passes against the Saints. Odunze’s downfield targets keep him in the FLEX conversation for fantasy purposes. He is in the WR3/FLEX ranks for Week 12 against the Lions.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rome Odunze caught 4-of-7 targets for 60 yards and a touchdown in the Bears’ Week 9 win over the Buccaneers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Odunze couldn’t quite haul in a touchdown throw from Caleb Williams on the first drive of the game, but on the next play, he was able to reach the end zone for his first touchdown of the 2026 season. He could have had another, but a perfect throw from Williams bounced off his hands with nothing but green grass in front of him. Still, it’s another competent game for the former first-round pick, and he’s reached 60 yards in each of his last three contests. Odunze belongs in the WR3 range for Week 11 against the Saints after a Week 10 bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rome Odunze caught 4-of-6 targets for 87 yards in the Bears’ Week 8 win over the Seahawks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Odunze was almost nonexistent in the first half, catching his first pass, an 18-yard reception over the middle of the field, with just under five minutes remaining in the second quarter. The Bears exploited the attention paid to Luther Burden and Colston Loveland after the half, with Odunze catching three passes for chunk gains in the third quarter to help position the team for their sixth victory. Odunze remains unlikely to challenge for the team lead in targets on a weekly basis while playing alongside Burden and Loveland, but his big play ability keeps him in the FLEX discussion, for the time being. That could change in a more favorable matchup through the air in Week 9 against the Buccaneers, where Odunze will be a WR3.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rome Odunze caught 4-of-5 targets for 69 yards in the Bears’ Week 7 win over the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: The yardage total goes down as Odunze’s second highest mark of the season as the third-year receiver was held out of the end zone for the seventh straight game to start the 2026 season. He did make three massive catches on third downs to help extend drives, making his mark felt more with quality than quantity. That doesn’t necessarily benefit fantasy managers that chased his big-play abilities this offseason as Odunze has largely been a fantasy dud outside of the Week 4 win over the Jets in which he returned 15.4 PPR points. He remains best left on fantasy benches ahead of another difficult test against the Seahawks in Week 8.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rome Odunze caught 3-of-4 targets for 39 yards in the Bears’ Week 6 win against the Falcons.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Odunze, who led the Bears in pass routes on the day, was third in targets while Luther Burden and Colston Loveland had big days with Caleb Williams back under center. Odunze was seeing more targets and air yards with the Bears’ backups QBs under center, though he should remain a high-variance flex in Week 7 against the Patriots. Odunze leads the Chicago offense with a 35 percent air yards share this season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rome Odunze caught 3-of-9 targets for 40 yards in the Bears’ Week 5 loss to the Packers, also losing a fumble.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Although the Bears were already losing 31-7, Odunze’s fourth quarter giveaway was an ill-advised decision on a fourth down catch-and-run where he had already secured a new set of downs. Odunze seemed to be extending the ball forward. Unnecessary. Like every Bears pass catcher, Odunze is treading fantasy water waiting for the return of Caleb Williams (hamstring). It appears that will be Week 6 against the Falcons, but Odunze’s returns have been uneven enough that not even Williams’ re-insertion under center will be enough to get Odunze above the mid-range WR3 ranks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rome Odunze caught 6-of-7 targets for 94 yards in the Bears’ Week 4 win against the Jets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Tyson Bagent, making his first NFL start, locked on to his boundary wideout in the first half, hitting Odunze for a couple long gains, including a nicely-placed 37 yarder. Odunze was second on the team in targets behind Colston Loveland, who saw nine looks on the day. Odunze is leading the Bears offense in air yards and profiles as a high-variance weekly fantasy option in an offense that leans toward the run. Odunze will be a solid flex option in Week 5 against a Green Bay secondary that struggles against boundary receivers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rome Odunze caught 3-of-6 targets for 44 yards in the Bears’ Week 3 win over the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Odunze continues to function as the deep threat in Ben Johnson’s offense, which spells trouble for his fantasy value in the immediate future considering the absence of Caleb Williams. Case Keenum got the start under center against the Eagles, and while he kept the offense on track through veteran savvy, his general lack of arm strength limited the offense to hefty rates of attacking the short-to-intermediate areas of the field. It is unclear whether Keenum or Tyson Bagent will draw the start in Week 4, but the decision could dictate whether Odunze can be inserted into fantasy rosters against the Jets.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rome Odunze caught 3-of-4 targets for 43 yards in the Bears’ Week 2 loss to the Vikings.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: It was Odunze’s second quiet statline in as many weeks to begin the season. The difference this time, of course, was the Bears scored only three points after dropping 59 on the Panthers in Week 1. They did attempt 35 passes, 26 of which came from Caleb Williams before he injured his hamstring midway through the fourth quarter. If Williams misses Week 3 against the Eagles as is currently looking likely, it would be difficult to jam Odunze into the WR3 ranks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.headline: Jonathon Brooks (groin) practiced in full on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.analysis: Brooks has a chance to face the Buccaneers this week, though Panthers coach Dave Canales acknowledged earlier this week that it will be tough to find a spot on the roster for him, due to special teams needs. Brooks is only a bench stash at this point.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.headline: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Trevor Etienne’s production and Tre Tyus’ special teams value make it “challenging” to find a spot for Jonathon Brooks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.analysis: Brooks, who is on injured reserve due to a groin injury, has eight days to be activated or lost for the season. The 23-year-old back practiced in full last week all three times only to not be activated. It would be great news for Chuba Hubbard if this continued, as the team has shown little interest in using Etienne in a real role in the backfield.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.headline: Panthers ruled out Jonathon Brooks (groin) for Week 11 against the Ravens.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.analysis: Brooks will miss his seventh consecutive game in Week 11, leaving Chuba Hubbard to a true workhorse role for another week. The matchup is less than ideal against the Ravens but fantasy managers can continue riding the bump in volume to a high end RB2 profile for the veteran back.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.headline: Jonathon Brooks (groin) is questionable for Carolina’s Week 11 game against the Ravens.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.analysis: Brooks practiced in full all three days this week and we’ve seen players pacing to be activated off injured reserve be given this soft questionable listing several times this year. Expect Brooks to play as Chuba Hubbard’s main backup. He’ll likely be brought along slowly in his first game back.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.headline: Jonathon Brooks (groin) is practicing in full for Week 11 against the Ravens.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.analysis: The Panthers listed Brooks as a full participant for two practices last week before amending his participation to limited at the end of the week. We doubt they’ll do that again. Panthers coach Dave Canales told reporters today that he thinks Brooks is “ready.” He can be speculatively stashed in 12-team leagues.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.headline: Panthers downgraded Jonathon Brooks (core) to out for Week 10 against the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.analysis: Brooks will miss his seventh consecutive game as he attempts to return from a core muscle injury. He managed a week of limited sessions before initially being listed as doubtful, ultimately ruled out. Chuba Hubbard will again serve as a legitimate workhorse in a plus matchup against the Saints and can be treated as a back-end RB1 in Week 10.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.headline: Jonathon Brooks (core) is doubtful for Week 10 against the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.analysis: Brooks was previously listed as a full participant in Wednesday’s and Thursday’s practices, only for head coach Dave Canales to announce on Friday that Brooks was working with the scout team, not the 53-man roster, meaning he was actually limited throughout the week. After logging three limited practices, Brooks appears unlikely to play in Week 10 given the doubtful designation. With his return window opened earlier this week, the Panthers could delay his return by two more weeks before having to either rule him out for the season or activate him from injured reserve. We will see how things go for him next week ahead of Week 11’s game against the Ravens.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.headline: Panthers designated Jonathon Brooks (core) to return from injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.analysis: Brooks practiced in full, giving him a shot at suiting up this week. However, it won’t surprise us if they give him another week of practice before putting him back on the field because of his lengthy injury history. With Chuba Hubbard excelling in his workhorse role this year, Brooks will likely be stuck with change-of-pace duties once healthy. He is only worth stashing in deeper fantasy formats.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.headline: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said the team is weighing whether or not to open Jonathon Brooks (core) return window this week
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.analysis: Canales said the oft-injured Brooks still has “some things to clear recovery-wise” but noted that he could still have his practice window opened this week. Brooks suffered a core muscle injury in Week 2 against the Falcons and handled just 11 touches in his first two games of the year. Given his injury history, it’s hard to know how close he could truly be to dressing on game day, but even when he does return, we would still expect Chuba Hubbard to handle the majority of touches given how efficient he has been this season. In addition to Brooks, Canales said the team is also weighing when to open the return window for Xavier Legette, who has been sidelined since Week 2 with a knee injury.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports Jonathon Brooks is expected to have core muscle surgery and will be placed on IR.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jonathon-b.analysis: Brooks will be sidelined for at least six weeks. It opens the door for Chuba Hubbard to dominate the Carolina backfield for the next month and a half, with AJ Dillon chipping in as a breather back. Through two game Hubbard leads the Panthers backfield with 22 rushes for 102 yards. He’s run a route on 50 percent of the team’s drop backs and have five targets. The Panthers, meanwhile, have the second highest pass rate over expected through Week 2. Hubbard will be a locked-in top-20 option going forward. Dillon can be stashed in case Hubbard gets dinged up while Brooks is recovering.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.headline: Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) is active for Week 12 against the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.analysis: The Eagles’ No. 1 cornerback is good to go this week. The Eagles declared EDGE Arnold Ebiketie, QB Cole Payton, CB Jonathan Jones, EDGE A.J. Epenesa, OT Ajani Cornelius and TE Grant Calcaterra inactive for Week 12 against the Cowboys. Payton is the emergency third quarterback.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.headline: Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) was limited in Tuesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.analysis: Eagles DC Vic Fangio said today he believed Mitchell would be able to go, and it seems like he’s trending in the right direction after hitting the practice field today. It would certainly help anyone facing CeeDee Lamb or George Pickens this week if Mitchell were able to go.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.headline: Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) did not practice on Monday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.analysis: It was an estimated session. Mitchell talked with reporters after leaving Sunday’s game with the hamstring ailment, implying it wasn’t a super serious injury. Still, on a short week, his status is up in the air. If he were ruled out, it would only help CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens on Thanksgiving.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.headline: Eagles CB Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) is not on Philadelphia’s final Week 7 injury report.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.analysis: Quinyanamo Bay is accepting Justin Jefferson applications for Week 7. We don’t think Jefferson is in any danger of getting shut out, but expectations should be somewhat tempered for the sure-fire WR1 against Philadelphia’s best cover corner.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.headline: Eagles CB Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) practiced in full on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.analysis: This is great news for the Eagles’ defense. Mitchell strained his hamstring in Week 6 and was unable to continue playing. He promisingly kicked off practice with a limited session this week, though, and his upgraded status today puts him firmly on track to face the Vikings this weekend. He will be needed if the Eagles hope to contain WRs Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.headline: Eagles CB Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.analysis: Mitchell suffered the hamstring injury in the second quarter of the Eagles’ Week 6 loss to the Giants. He did not return after halftime and was later ruled out. A limited practice this early in the week is a good sign for his availability ahead of Week 7. If healthy, Mitchell will be tasked with covering Justin Jefferson on Sunday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.headline: Eagles CB Quinyon Mitchell suffered a hamstring injury in Philadelphia’s Week 6 game against the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.analysis: Shaken up in the second quarter, Mitchell returned to the Eagles’ sideline with a wool cap instead of a helmet. That is where he remained to begin the third frame. He was soon declared out. Mitchell’s loss further thins an already-undermanned position group for the Eagles, and is a huge boost for Giants QB Jaxson Dart in his third career start. Adoree’ Jackson has taken his place. The only good news is Mitchell has 10 days to try to heal up for a Week 7 matchup with the Vikings.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.headline: Eagles DC Vic Fangio told reporters that the team is “preparing for the possibility” of CB Quinyon Mitchell shadowing opposing wide receivers this year.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.analysis: It sounds like this could be a matchup-specific tactic, in the event that Mitchell “might need to travel with wide receivers or play receivers on different sides of the field.” In his breakout rookie season last year, Mitchell logged 1,080 snaps on the defensive right side of the field and zero on the defensive left. If he can handle it, this would make the Eagles’ top-tier defense even stronger.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.headline: Jared Verse was named Defensive Rookie of the Year.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.analysis: Verse was named the winner of the award after receiving 37 of the 50 first-place votes. The 24-year-old was a force for the Los Angeles defense in 2024 while picking up 4.5 sacks and forcing four fumbles. He led all edge players in Pro Football Focus’ charting with 66 hurries while helping the Rams to a division title. Quinyon Mitchell finished second with nine first-place votes, and Verse’s teammate Braden Fiske finished third.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.headline: Eagles RT Lane Johnson told the Philadelphia Inquirer that “four or five” players on the team were dealing with illnesses.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/quinyon-mi.analysis: Defensive tackle Jalen Carter missed Wednesday’s practice with an undisclosed illness, and rookie Quinyon Mitchell is reportedly dealing with laryngitis. In addition to Johnson, defensive coordinator Vic Fangio also mentioned multiple players dealing with illnesses, but none are expected to miss Sunday’s game as a result. These illnesses will likely prove to be little more than a footnote on Super Bowl weekend when all is said and done.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.headline: Nick Herbig (hip/ribs) is not on the final injury report and will play in Week 12 against the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.analysis: Herbig is good to go. Steelers LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) and OG Gennings Dunker (knee) are ruled out. Steelers LB Cole Holcomb (heel) is questionable.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.headline: Nick Herbig (ribs/hip) is questionable for Pittsburgh’s Week 11 game against the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.analysis: He did not practice at all this week, though it’s possible he’s just going to be able to play through the pain on Sunday and the Steelers are taking it easy on him. Patrick Queen (hand) is also questionable, but got in a full session on Friday and we’re optimistic about his chances of returning.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.headline: Nick Herbig (ribs/hip) did not practice on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.analysis: Herbig is on the wrong side of questionable for the Steelers’ Week 11 game against the Eagles. Hopefully, he can get healthy before long. Patrick Queen (hand) remains limited, but he is on track to play this weekend.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.headline: Nick Herbig (ribs/hip) did not practice on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.analysis: Herbig hobbled off the field in the Steelers’ Week 10, Monday Night Football game against the Bengals. Patrick Queen (hand) was limited today, and the Steelers designated Gennings Dunker (knee) to return from injured reserve. He is practicing fully this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport believes that the Steelers are likely to keep EDGE T.J. Watt and EDGE Alex Highsmith on the roster for 2026.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.analysis: Watt, 31, and Highsmith, 28, were the starting EDGE rushers last year. Their 24-year-old backup, LB Nick Herbig, signed a four-year, $100 million extension on Tuesday, prompting questions as to whether the Steelers could consider trading away one of their two veterans. Highsmith was not present at mandatory minicamp on Wednesday, but this was reportedly due to a stomach bug , not discontent over his backup’s big payday. Per Rapoport, Watt’s “enormous” contract, coupled with the amount of money the Steelers have invested elsewhere in their EDGE unit, means that they will probably “have a decision to make” in 2027.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.headline: Steelers signed LB Nick Herbig to a four-year, $100 million extension.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.analysis: $42 million of this money is guaranteed per NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo. Herbig was entering the final year of his rookie contract and coming off a career-high 7.5 sacks. The extension locks him in next to Alex Highsmith and J.J. Watt, and the Steelers would have three separate edge players on $20 million cap hits in 2027 if they all stayed. This extension sure seems to forecast that either Highsmith or Watt isn’t long for Pittsburgh.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.headline: Steelers declared EDGE Nick Herbig, WR Roman Wilson, QB Will Howard, CB James Pierre, OG Isaac Seumalo, OLB T.J. Watt, and DL Logan Lee inactive for Week 16 against the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.analysis: Watt remains out because of a partially collapsed lung. Herbig was listed as doubtful because of a hamstring issue. The Lions should have an easy time picking apart the Steelers today.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.headline: Steelers EDGE T.J. Watt (lung) will not play in Pittsburgh’s Week 16 game against the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.analysis: Watt didn’t practice all week, but was spotted in the facility today. Perhaps we’ll get more clarity from him before the end of the day on the timeline for his recovery, he obviously wasn’t close to playing after not practicing all week. Fellow EDGE Nick Herbig (hamstring) is doubtful after a limited session on Friday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.headline: Steelers EDGE T.J. Watt (lung) did not practice on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.analysis: It definitely appears to be trending towards Watt missing another week after emergency surgery to repair a partially-collapsed lung last week. He hasn’t practiced since, understandably so. The Steelers will likely be without their best pass rusher against the Lions. Nick Herbig (hamstring) also missed his second-straight practice on Thursday and seems unlikely to go in Week 16.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.headline: Steelers declared Nick Herbig (hamstring) inactive for Pittsburgh’s Week 1 game against the Jets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/nick-herbi.analysis: Herbig was on the questionable tag and should be considered questionable for Week 2 at this point. Also inactive for the Steelers are: DT Derrick Harmon (knee), QB Skylar Thompson (third quarterback/hamstring), G Max Scharping, G Andrus Peat, and DT Esezi Otomewo. The latter three are all healthy scratches.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ben-skowro.headline: Steelers placed Ben Skowronek on injured reserve with a calf injury.
