The closest he came to actually putting points on the board was a double-covered bomb to Carnell Tate’s general area. It was, well, what you would have expected from both sides in the preseason. Ward remains a last gasp supeflex QB2 heading into Week 6’s game against the Colts.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Cam Ward completed 20-of-31 passes for 222 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the Titans’ 24-18, Week 4 loss to the Ravens, adding four carries for 27 additional yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Ward’s second pass of the game resulted in an interception, but he would settle in to put together his most productive outing of the season. Ward linked up with rookie first-rounder Carnell Tate on multiple long gains and ended the day with four completions of 20-plus yards. The two would connect on a 33-yard pass late in the fourth quarter on a fourth-and-10, and on the next play, Ward would find Wan’Dale Robinson for a three-yard score to cut the Ravens’ lead to 24-18. Ward did a good job at evading pressure in this one. Despite being pressured on 11 dropbacks, per PFF, only one of those resulted in a sack. Ward has been sacked just once over the last two weeks, but will have a tough challenge ahead of him next week when the Titans play host to the Texans. Ward projects as a low-end QB2 next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.headline: Tyler Bass converted on 4-of-5 field goal attempts in the Bills’ Week 11 win over the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.analysis: Bass was the beneficiary of the Bills’ offense continuing to stall out once they got into the Dolphins’ territory. Bass made field goals of 43, 54, 40, and 28 yards on the day. However, the 29-year-old did miss a 54-yarder in the third quarter, which was his first missed field goal of the season. He’s now 24-of-25 on the season after missing all of last year with an injury.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.headline: Bills revised the contract of K Tyler Bass.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.analysis: Bass missed all of the 2025 season due to a hip/groin injury. The sixth-year vet will earn $1 million in guaranteed money next season with a chance to earn up to $3.5 million in additional incentives, per NFL Network’s Tom Pelissero. Bass converted 24-of-29 field goals when he last played while going 4-of-4 on kicks of 50-plus yards. Bass has two years left on his current deal.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.headline: Bills GM Brandon Beane said K Tyler Bass (hip/groin) is expected to be Buffalo’s kicker in 2026.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.analysis: Beane noted there was an outside chance that Bass could have kicked in the Super Bowl had the Bills made it, leaving us to believe that there’s little doubt he’ll be available at the start of next season. Bass missed the entire 2025 regular season with the injury.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.headline: Bills HC Sean McDermott said Tyler Bass (hip/groin) will not return this season.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.analysis: Bass was placed on injured reserve before the start of the season and has not played a game. McDermott said Bass recently underwent surgery, which would sideline him for the remainder of the year, leaving kicking duties to Matt Prater for the rest of the way. Bass signed a four-year extension with the Bills in 2023 and should be back as the Bills’ kicker in 2026 if all goes well with his recovery.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.headline: Bills placed K Tyler Bass (hip/groin) on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.analysis: He’ll miss at least the first four weeks of the season. Friendship ended with Tyler Bass, now Matt Prater is your best friend in fantasy leagues where you want kicker points from the Bills.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.headline: Bills K Tyler Bass (left hip/groin) did not practice on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.analysis: Bass was a limited participant in Wednesday’s practice. Things evidently did not go well because the Bills signed free agent K Matt Prater earlier today. Bass appears to be highly unlikely to play in Week 1 against the Ravens.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.headline: Bills signed K Matt Prater to the practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.analysis: Tyler Bass is dealing with a groin injury and was limited in Wednesday’s practice. Prater will be called up from the practice squad if Bass can’t suit up for Week 1. Prater went 6-of-6 on his field goal tries with the Cardinals in 2024 before missing the remainder of the season with a torn meniscus.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.headline: Free agent K Eddy Pineiro worked out for the Bills on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.analysis: Fellow free agent kickers Zane Gonzalez and Greg Joseph also worked out for the Bills. Incumbent K Tyler Bass struggled last season and dealt with a pelvis injury in training camp. The Bills are likely just covering their bases, but Bass could be a risky fantasy pick at this time.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.headline: Bills HC Sean McDermott said Tyler Bass will kick for the team in Week 7 against the Titans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.analysis: The Bills signed kicker Lucas Havrisik this week to serve as competition for Bass, who has converted on 9-of-12 field goals this season and 18-of-20 extra points. The Bills signed Bass to a four-year extension last offseason, so we wouldn’t expect them to rush to move on from him. With that said, they’re clearly open to the idea with Havrisik now in the building.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.headline: Bills signed K Tyler Bass to a four-year extension through 2027.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-bass.analysis: The deal is worth “up to” $21 million. That’s a meaningless number, especially for a kicker, but it does include a robust $12.3 million guaranteed. It’s a deserved extension for a 26-year-old who has converted north of 87 percent of his field goal attempts each of the past two seasons in one of the toughest weather divisions in football. Bass doesn’t have the biggest leg, but his accuracy is more than sufficient for the Super Bowl-or-bust Bills.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.headline: Greg Dulcich caught 2-of-7 targets for 12 yards in the Dolphins’ Week 11 loss to the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.analysis: Dulcich saw the second-most targets on the team but ran a route on just 16 of the Dolphins’ 36 dropbacks. It’s nice to see Kyle McCord target him so often when he’s on the field, but Dulcich is not producing enough to be under consideration in fantasy leagues.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.headline: Greg Dulcich failed to catch either of his two targets in the Dolphins’ Week 10 loss to the Colts.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.analysis: Dulcich saw just two targets on the day but did not reel either of them in. Kyle McCord targeted him on a red zone fourth down in the second quarter, but the ball was tipped and fell incomplete. Six teams going on bye in Week 11 means Dulcich still nets low-end TE2 consideration against the Bills.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.headline: Greg Dulcich caught 2-of-4 targets for 14 yards in the Dolphins’ Week 9 loss to the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.analysis: Despite the quiet fantasy outing, Dulcich finished second on the team in catches and yards. If you couldn’t tell, it was not a productive day for Miami’s passing attack. Dulcich had stacked a few usable weeks over the past month, but Week 9 was his breakout spot against a dreadful Detroit defense. Having missed his big opportunity, he’ll return to the back of the TE2 ranks for Week 10 against the Colts.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.headline: Greg Dulcich caught 4-of-6 targets for 43 yards in the Dolphins’ Week 8 loss to the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.analysis: Three of Dulcich’s catches occurred on the final two drives, and his first catch occurred in the two-minute drill at the end of the first half. Malik Willis seemingly only looks his way when playing quickly. Maybe the coaching staff should address that, because Dulcich played effectively in those situations. The Dolphins face the Lions’ fantasy-friendly pass defense next week, potentially elevating Dulcich to high-end TE2 status.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.headline: Greg Dulcich is not on Miami’s final Week 8 injury report.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.analysis: The fringe TE2 life awaits Dulcich against the Patriots on Sunday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.headline: Greg Dulcich (ankle) remained limited in Thursday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.analysis: Still, back-to-back practices are a good sign that Dulcich will be ready to go for Week 8’s game against the Patriots. That isn’t necessarily an endorsement of using him in fantasy football — even after last week’s surprise 5/86 against the Jets — but hey, the Dolphins will be glad he’s around.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.headline: Greg Dulcich (ankle) was limited on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.analysis: The Dolphins’ tight end finally had a decent game, only to tweak an ankle along the way. He should be fine for Week 8 against the Patriots, but he is barely in the TE2 ranks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.headline: Greg Dulcich caught all five of his targets for 86 yards in the Dolphins’ Week 7 win over the Jets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.analysis: Dulcich made the most of National Tight Ends Day with a 32-yard catch on the Dolphins’ opening drive and two more gains of 15+ yards throughout the contest. He led the team in catches and targets. Dulcich now has at least four receptions in three of his past four games. Miami’s run-first approach is preventing him from finding spike weeks, but Dulcich has worked himself into the TE2 conversation ahead of Week 8.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.headline: Greg Dulcich caught 4-of-5 targets for 37 yards in the Dolphins’ Week 5 loss to the Bengals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.analysis: Dulcich also added a two-point conversion to his total. It was a low-efficiency passing offense for the Dolphins once again, leading to Dulcich averaging under 10 yards per reception. The 26-year-old tight end is a fantasy TE3 as the Dolphins head into a Week 6 bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.headline: Greg Dulcich caught 5-of-7 targets for 55 yards in the Dolphins’ Week 3 loss to the Chiefs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/greg-dulci.analysis: Held under 20 yards in each of the Dolphins’ first two games, Dulcich finally had something of a pop-up effort as the ‘Fins tried in vain to match points with the Chiefs. It was nice to get some proof of TE2 concept, but it is going to be exceptionally difficult for Dulcich to carve out streamer value in a low-volume passing attack focused on seeing what it has in its intriguing rookie receivers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.headline: Chris Bell caught 1-of-4 targets for eight yards in the Dolphins’ Week 11 loss to the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.analysis: Bell was questionable to return to the game after suffering a chest injury in the second quarter; however, he did return and ran 20 routes on 36 dropbacks, which was the third-most on the team. Bell still has a decent future given his pre-knee-injury upside, but it’s tough to roster him in redraft leagues right now.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.headline: Chris Bell is questionable to return to Week 11 against the Bills with a chest injury.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.analysis: Bell and Bills safety Damar Hamlin collided on a Hamlin interception in the second quarter. It seemed like Bell and Hamlin slammed their helmets into one another, but Bell’s injury designation says chest. It’s been a season of tough injury luck for Bell, who has battled a knee injury all season after having offseason surgery.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.headline: Chris Bell (knee) is not on Miami’s final Week 11 injury report.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.analysis: He’ll play against the Bills. It’s not exactly a smash play after he missed last week’s game with some soreness in his surgically-repaired knee, but it’s certainly plausible that Bell will be in the fantasy discussion in Week 12 if he proves healthy and able this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.headline: Chris Bell (knee) was limited on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.analysis: Bell reportedly hyperextended his knee last week, hence his day-to-day labeling this week. Bell had been limited from time to time already this year by soreness in his surgically repaired knee. The fact that this is unrelated is actually good news. He has a chance to play in Week 11 against the Bills.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.headline: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Chris Bell (knee) is considered “day-to-day.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.analysis: Bell was playing through some soreness in his surgically repaired knee until he was forced to sit last week. He was suited up for practice today, though we expect it to be a limited session for the rookie. The Dolphins will need to see how he responds to a week of practice before making a decision on his Week 11 availability.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.headline: Chris Bell (knee) is inactive for Week 10 against the Colts.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.analysis: Bell entered the weekend doubtful after re-aggravating his knee in practice and not practicing on Thursday or Friday. Despite the absence of Bell, no Dolphins pass-catchers get a boost with Kyle McCord at quarterback. Dolphins also declared OL Aaron Brewer, CB Marcellas Dial Jr., TE Justin Joly, WR Jared Wayne, and OL Caedan Wallace inactive for Week 10 against the Colts.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.headline: Chris Bell (knee) is doubtful for Miami’s Week 10 game against the Colts.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.analysis: He did not practice Thursday or Friday after aggravating his surgically repaired knee in practice on Wednesday. The Dolphins have no reason to push Bell, so we’d be stunned if he played. Not that you were looking for reasons to lean into a Kyle McCord start, but Bell’s injury should free up targets for Malik Washington and Caleb Douglas on the FLEX line.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.headline: Chris Bell (knee) did not practice on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.analysis: The Dolphins were regularly limiting Bell’s practice reps earlier this season, so this may just be routine maintenance. The rookie wide receiver was limited yesterday. Bell has not yet established himself as a fantasy-relevant player, and he is unlikely to do so in Kyle McCord’s first start, especially if his surgically repaired knee is bothering him.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.headline: Chris Bell failed to catch his only target in the Dolphins’ Week 9 loss to the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.analysis: With nine targets over his previous two games, Bell looked to be building some momentum headed into Week 9. Instead, he posted the dreaded goose egg. The good news is that Bell ran a route on 77 percent of Malik Willis’s dropbacks. He’s running as the team’s WR3, but there’s barely enough passing volume to keep the WR1 in the FLEX mix. Bell remains an interesting dynasty stash, but he is not on the redraft radar headed into Week 10.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.headline: Chris Bell caught 4-of-5 targets for 31 yards in the Dolphins’ Week 8 loss to the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-sar.analysis: The third-round rookie was limited to short-area work in today’s loss to the Patriots, but his five targets and four receptions both tie for career highs. He also lost two yards on a run play. Bell has had a few gaffes this year, but he is seemingly recovering well from last year’s ACL surgery. He is a player worth stashing on benches in many 12-team leagues, and could warrant WR5 treatment against the Lions next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.headline: Malik Washington caught 3-of-6 targets for 30 yards in the Dolphins’ Week 11 loss to the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.analysis: He also added two rushes for 11 yards. Washington made a tremendous one-handed catch on a fourth-down conversion late in the game, but there wasn’t much else happening for him on the day. His six targets were the third-most on the team, but he ran a route on 32 of the team’s 36 dropbacks, which was the most on the team. He’s a risky FLEX play against the Jets next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.headline: Malik Washington caught 3-of-3 targets for 50 yards in the Dolphins’ Week 10 loss to the Colts, completing his sole passing attempt for 34 yards and a touchdown.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.analysis: Washington led all Dolphins wide receivers in snaps, but fell behind Caleb Douglas and Kevin Coleman in targets. He caught all three of his targets, including a circus catch to reel in a dangerous throw from Kyle McCord in the third quarter. The Dolphins also dialed up some trickery in the second quarter with Washington taking a toss and finding Jalen Tolbert downfield for a 34-yard passing touchdown. Ultimately, Washington is on the field a lot for the Dolphins and still ranks in the WR4 range for Week 11 against the Bills.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.headline: Malik Washington caught 2-of-3 targets for 21 yards in the Dolphins’ Week 9 loss to the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.analysis: Washington wasn’t awfully involved in this game, even if you account for the Dolphins’ low-volume passing approach. He earned a 12 percent target share and added one carry for zero yards. Caleb Douglas, on the other hand, was the runaway WR1 for Miami. He earned eight targets and led the team with six grabs for 70 yards. Already completely out of the playoff race, the Dolphins are in evaluation mode with their young receiver corps. That could mean increasing workloads for Douglas, Chris Bell, and Kevin Coleman. Washington will get another week in the WR4 ranks, but he could be waiver wire fodder if he posts another quiet game against the Colts next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.headline: Malik Washington caught 5-of-6 targets for 40 yards and one touchdown in the Dolphins’ Week 8 loss to the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.analysis: Washington continues to play well as a short-area pass catcher, though he did haul in a 23-yarder downfield. He got leveled on the Dolphins’ fifth drive, and Patriots LB Christian Ellis received an unnecessary roughness penalty for the act. It briefly seemed like Washington’s day might be over, but he returned a few plays later to score a one-yard touchdown via a quick out route after going in motion pre-snap. Today’s stat line allowed Washington to clear the century mark in career catches (103). Among NFL wide receivers with at least 100 receptions from 2021-26, Washington’s 8.4 yards per reception ranks dead last. He is a WR4/FLEX against the Lions in Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.headline: Malik Washington (knee) is not on Miami’s final Week 8 injury report.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.analysis: Washington’s WR4 status will continue aplomb against the Patriots in Week 8, though Caleb Douglas’ return probably has capped his ceiling case for the time being.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.headline: Malik Washington (knee) was limited in Thursday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.analysis: Back-to-back limited sessions probably leave Washington in a good spot for Week 8. He’s more likely than not to be cleared off the injury report on Friday as long as there’s not a sudden downgrade.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.headline: Malik Washington (knee) was limited on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.analysis: Washington has cooled off in recent weeks. Although his knee injury is unlikely to keep him out of the Dolphins’ Week 8 matchup against the Patriots, he is barely a WR5 in fantasy football. Washington does not need to be rostered in 12-team leagues.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.headline: Malik Washington caught all three of his targets for 27 yards in the Dolphins’ Week 7 win over the Jets, adding two carries for eight yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.analysis: Washington’s previous season-low in targets was five. He had also reached at least 43 receiving yards in every game before today. It shouldn’t come as a surprise that his worst box score of the season came in Caleb Douglas’s first game back from a month-long absence. With more competition for targets on a team that doesn’t want to pass the football, Washington is trending in the wrong direction headed into Week 8. He will be a low-end WR4 versus the Patriots next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.headline: Malik Washington caught 6-of-8 targets for 43 yards in the Dolphins’ Week 5 loss to the Bengals, adding one carry for 19 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.analysis: Washington was the most involved Dolphins receiver, leading the team in targets and receiving yards. He started things off with an 18-yard rush and saw a steady peppering of low-depth targets. Though he led all Dolphins skill-position players in snaps, Washington doesn’t see many scoring opportunities in the Miami offense. After a Week 6 bye, The 25-year-old is a volume-based FLEX play Week 7 against the Jets.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.headline: Malik Washington caught 5-of-5 targets for 67 yards in the Dolphins’ Week 4 loss to the Vikings, adding two rushes for three yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/malik-wash.analysis: Washington remains one of the Dolphins’ primary returners despite his increased receiving involvement. His day began with a muffed punt that he successfully recovered in the end zone for a touchback. Things improved from there. Washington delivered multiple double-digit gains, functioning effectively as a weapon behind the line of scrimmage and in the flats. He also turned in a 17-yarder via a corner route on play action. Rookie WR Caleb Douglas (ankle) may return for next week’s game against the Saints. If he remains sidelined, Washington should be FLEX-viable, though his ceiling is questionable.

https://www.nbcsports.com/roman-wilson/0.headline: Roman Wilson caught 3-of-6 targets for 43 yards in the Steelers’ Week 11 loss to the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/roman-wilson/0.analysis: Returning from a finger injury, Wilson ran a route on 41 of the team’s 59 drop backs and was second to Max Hurleman in receptions and receiving yards. Aaron Rodgers nearly connected with the speedy Wilson on a long ball in the second half. Wilson’s playing time may have been affected by DK Metcalf’s second half ejection after repeated fights with Philadelphia defenders. Wilson will have some deep league value in the run-first Steelers offense, including next week against the Broncos.

https://www.nbcsports.com/roman-wilson/0.headline: Roman Wilson (finger) is active for Week 11 against the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/roman-wilson/0.analysis: Wilson, who accounted for 16 percent of the Steelers’ targets and 39 percent of the team’s air yards before sustaining a finger injury in Week 5, will make his return to the lineup and likely make Germie Bernard all but unplayable in 12-team leagues. Wilson can be slotted in as a high-variance flex or second flex against the Eagles. The Steelers declared WR Kaden Wetjen, QBs Drew Allar Will Howard, Sean Murphy-Bunting, RB Eli Heidenreich, OLB Nick Herbig, and DL Gabe Rubio inactive.

https://www.nbcsports.com/roman-wilson/0.headline: Steelers activated WR Roman Wilson (hand) from injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/roman-wilson/0.analysis: Wilson ended up staying on injured reserve for the minimum four games as he dealt with a hand injury, returning to a roster approaching full health, although fellow wide receiver Michael Pittman was not activated from injured reserve ahead of Week 11.Fantasy managers are likely only able to confidently start Metcalf against the Eagles on Sunday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/roman-wilson/0.headline: ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reports Steelers WR Roman Wilson is expected to miss a “couple of weeks” after suffering a finger injury in Week 5 against the Colts.

He pinned the reception to his hip, but the ball was ripped loose by a defender, which not only made the pass incomplete but also seemed to dislocate Wilson’s finger. With Michael Pittman Jr. also hurt, we should continue to see a lot of Germie Bernard in Week 5.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.headline: Dawson Knox caught 2-of-3 targets for 31 yards in the Bills’ Week 11 win over the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.analysis: Despite Dalton Kincaid not being active on Sunday, Knox was not a huge part of the passing game. He did run a route on 29 of 52 dropbacks, which was fourth-most on the team, but he simply wasn’t targeted much. Kincaid is expected to return on Thursday against the Chiefs, which keeps Knox off the fantasy radar.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.headline: Dalton Kincaid is inactive for Week 11 against the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.analysis: Kincaid was listed as questionable with (thumb/ankle) injuries, but he will not suit up. This makes sense as a cautionary move for the Bills, who already ruled out starting cornerback Christian Benford and starting linebacker Dorian Williams. The Bills are nearly a 17-point favorite against the Dolphins on Sunday and then will face the Chiefs on Thursday night. Except Dawson Knox to be more involved in this game in Week 11, but we wouldn’t be surprised if the Bills are running the ball a lot in the second half. The Bills’ full inactives are: WR Skyler Bell, TE Dalton Kincaid, OT Jude Bowry, DL T.J. Sanders, ILB Dorian Williams, OLB Mike Danna, and CB Christian Benford.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.headline: Dawson Knox caught 4-of-5 targets for 37 yards in the Bills’ Week 9 win over the Vikings.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.analysis: The blocking tight end saw his snaps and routes increased against the blitz-heavy Vikings, with his 37 yards finishing second on the team behind Khalil Shakir. Even so, Knox remains unlikely to return weekly fantasy production as the blocking specialist in the run-first Buffalo offense, leaving him well outside of weekly fantasy consideration moving forward.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.headline: Dawson Knox caught both targets for five yards and a touchdown in the Bills’ Week 2 win over the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.analysis: Knox cashed in on a touchdown grab from one yard out in the second quarter for his first score of the season. While his snaps should remain high in an offense that rotates pass-catchers at an elevated rate, his primary contribution remains his blocking prowess. He remains a player unlikely to contribute meaningful counting stats on a weekly basis and is best left on the waiver wire.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.headline: Bills re-signed TE Dawson Knox to a three-year contract extension.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.analysis: Terms weren’t available, but it almost certainly will lower his 2026 cap figure after he came into the offseason as a release candidate. The Bills clearly value Knox’s blocking and relationship with Josh Allen. He remains a decent bet to pop off for the odd TE1 game here or there, but Dalton Kincaid should be the most-targeted tight end for the Bills again in 2026.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.headline: The Athletic’s Joe Buscaglia believes Dawson Knox is a candidate to be released.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.analysis: The Bills would save $9.6 million in cap space with a release of the veteran tight end, and Jaxson Hawes played well enough in his rookie season to believe he could step into a featured role as the No. 1 blocking tight end. Given how deep the Bills are in cap hell — they project to be over the cap by $7 million before the offseason starts — lopping off Knox definitely is in play at this point. Buscaglia also projects Curtis Samuel ($6.05 million in cap savings) and Ty Johnson ($2.45 million) as potential candidates for release as the Bills look to get cap compliant.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.headline: Dawson Knox caught 3-of-5 targets for 32 yards in the Bills’ Divisional Round loss to the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.analysis: The one target that will stand out the most is Josh Allen missing Knox for what could have been a game-winning touchdown in the final seconds of regulation. It’s a pass the two have connected on multiple times throughout the years, but the ball simply sailed over Knox’s head and into the end zone. On the season, Knox played in all 17 games, five more than his tight end teammate Dalton Kincaid, totaling 417 receiving yards and four touchdowns on 36 catches. The 29-year-old is set to make $10.7 million next season, but the Bills could opt out of that deal and take $7.4 million in dead cap if they wanted to. It’s a situation to monitor this offseason, but that’s a large dead cap hit for a team to take.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.headline: Dawson Knox caught all three of his targets for 30 yards in the Bills’ Wild Card Round win over the Jaguars.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.analysis: Knox, Brandin Cooks, and Dalton Kincaid all tied for second on the team in catches. Khalil Shakir led the way with 12 grabs and 82 yards. Knox is a reliable backup tight end and a plus blocker, but his fantasy outlook is limited. He needs to get in the end zone to pay off and that has only happened four times this year. Knox is only worth a look in large-field DFS tournaments for the Divisional Round.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.headline: Dalton Kincaid (knee) practiced in a limited capacity on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.analysis: Kincaid should be able to suit up in the Wild Card round against the Jaguars if he can practice in some capacity on Thursday and Friday. Kincaid, who had three receptions for 48 yards last week against the Jets, could be a key player for Buffalo as they face the NFL’s most extreme pass-funnel defense. Jacksonville allows 8.7 tight end targets per game, the second highest mark in the league.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.headline: Dawson Knox caught both of his targets for 24 yards and a touchdown in the Bills’ Week 18 win over the Jets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dawson-kno.analysis: Knox came into the game needing seven receiving yards to earn $100K in incentives. He not only earned that, but also netted himself another $100K with his touchdown. Not bad for just one drive of work.

https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.headline: Keon Coleman caught 2-of-4 targets for 17 yards in the Bills’ Week 11 win over the Dolphins.

It didn’t result in fantasy success, but it seems like Coleman has evolved into the “dirty work” receiver in Buffalo who can move the chains with tough catches and pick up key blocks in the running game. He’s not a fantasy option next week against the Chiefs.

https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.headline: Keon Coleman (ankle) is practicing in full for Week 11 against the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.analysis: Coleman should be able to face Miami this weekend. The Bills will likely employ a run-heavy approach, though with Kyle McCord starting on the other side. Coleman is only a boom-bust FLEX at this time.

https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.headline: Keon Coleman caught 1-of-3 passes for 11 yards in the Bills’ Week 10 win over the Jets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.analysis: Coleman did make an impressive second catch in traffic, but the play was called back due to an illegal shift penalty. He also took a hit to his helmet on the same play and had to go into the blue medical tent. He was eventually cleared and returned to play, but it’s a situation to watch at practice this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.headline: Keon Coleman (shoulder) was limited on Friday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.analysis: Coleman’s fantasy-scoring outlook has been hurt by his teammate’s improving health. At this point, Coleman is more so a single-game DFS FLEX rather than a starter in 12-team re-draft formats. He should be good to go for Week 9’s Monday Night Football game though.

https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.headline: Keon Coleman (shoulder) was limited on Thursday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.headline: Keon Coleman caught 4-of-6 targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in the Bills’ Week 6 win over the Raiders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.analysis: Coleman’s six targets tied for second-most on the Bills with Khalil Shakir, who also found the end zone in this one. Coleman scored on an impressive 12-yard play by Josh Allen, who appeared ready to take off and run with the ball before spotting Coleman open in the end zone and flipping a shovel pass to him for the score. Coleman has now scored in three straight games and has been targeted six or more times in two of his last three. With the Bills now heading into their Week 7 bye, Coleman could face more target competition when they return in Week 8 against the Ravens if DJ Moore (shoulder) is active. Moore was questionable entering this week and ruled out 90 minutes before kickoff, so it wouldn’t be surprising if he was a full-go after the bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.headline: Keon Coleman caught 1-of-2 targets for seven yards and a touchdown in the Bills’ Week 5 win over the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.analysis: Coleman was largely erased by the lockdown corner play of the Rams but had a receiving line also heavily influenced by a ground-heavy game plan from a Bills team that attempted only 19 passes in almost 70 minutes of football. It was quite the letdown fantasy performance for managers looking to take advantage of the absences of both DJ Moore and Joshua Palmer. Coleman is a borderline FLEX play in Week 6 against the Raiders, pending the status of Moore.

https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.headline: Joshua Palmer (shoulder) was added to the injury report on Friday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.analysis: Palmer seemingly injured his shoulder in practice today. The Bills may already be without WR DJ Moore (shoulder) on Monday night. While Palmer is not relevant in 12-team leagues, his potential absence would improve Keon Coleman’s stock.

https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.analysis: Coleman should be good to go for the Bills’ Monday Night Football game against the Rams this week. https://www.nbcsports.com/keon-coleman/0.analysis: This was the best game we’ve seen from Coleman in a long time. Not only did he show up in the box score, but two of his catches were unbelievable sideline grabs that showed the type of hands that made him an intriguing draft pick out of Florida State. He played on 46 of the team’s 59 snaps and ran a route on 31 of their 40 dropbacks. With D.J. Moore leaving this game with a shoulder injury, Coleman is a priority add on waiver wires before next week’s game against the Rams.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: Fehoko caught his lone catchable pass for a 21-yard play-action gain on the opening drive. His second target was off-target and resulted in an incompletion. Fehoko does not need to be rostered for the Cardinals’ Week 11 game against the Chiefs.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: Fehoko had a tough go in 2025. In the Cardinals’ Week 10 game against the Seahawks, Fehoko badly sprained an ankle on a special teams play. He returned to the game after having it taped up and then broke his arm making a tackle on the following kickoff. Fehoko, 28, also failed to earn a target last season. He will likely function as a run blocker and special teams player and should not be drafted this season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Cardinals signed RB Michael Carter to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: Carter surprisingly lost out to Zonovan Knight for the final roster spot at running back, but decided to remain with the Cardinals practice squad. Joining him so far are: WR Andre Baccellia, LB Elliott Brown, OL Jeremiah Byers, OL Jake Curhan, TE Josiah Deguara, WR Simi Fehoko, DL Anthony Goodlow, CB Darren Hall, OL Sincere Haynesworth, OL Nick Leverett, WR Tejhaun Palmer and DL Elijah Simmons.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Cardinals waived WR Simi Fehoko.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: He announced the news via TikTok by saying the “grim reaper done got me.” Fehoko played 41 preseason snaps and finished with a 71.6 PFF offensive grade. The 28-year-old has a shot to catch on elsewhere as an end-of-roster or practice squad possession receiver. He has 310 career NFL snaps over the last four seasons.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Cardinals signed WR Simi Fehoko, formerly of the Chargers, to a one-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: Typically a special teamer, Fehoko set season highs across the board on offense last year with six catches for 106 yards. An elbow injury cost him the second half of the season. Fehoko is a depth option at receiver but brings more to the table through his special teams production. He will need to maintain a special teams role in Arizona to secure a roster spot.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Chargers activated WR Simi Fehoko (elbow) from injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: LA also brought Eli Apple off IR. Both players will fill depth roles for the Chargers’ in their Wild Card Round matchup with Houston. With Josh Palmer ruled out, Fehoko could be in the mix for WR3 duties along with DJ Chark.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Simi Fehoko (elbow) practiced in full on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: Fehoko has a chance to return from injured reserve this week. No. 2 WR Quentin Johnston (thigh/illness) and Joshua Palmer (heel) were both sidelined on Wednesday so Fehoko’s improvement comes at the right time. He could suit up as the Chargers’ No. 3 WR this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Chargers placed WR Simi Fehoko on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: The team signed Jalen Reagor to their active roster in a corresponding move. Reagor and DJ Chark will serve as depth options in the Chargers’ receiving rotation. Chark was activated from injured reserve last week but did not suit up on Sunday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Simi Fehoko caught his only target for a nine-yard touchdown in the Chargers’ Week 8 win over the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: Fehoko saw a fleeting window of additional snaps as Joshua Palmer left the game for one possession after aggravating his knee injury, a drive that culminated in a nine-yard touchdown grab on a crossing route over the middle of the field. He won’t be a fantasy option even if Palmer misses time.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 9-of-14 targets for 54 yards in Arizona’s Week 11 loss to the Chiefs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: It sure does feel hard to find overall TE1 upside the past few weeks with Michael Wilson on the shelf. McBride was peppered with targets in the blowout loss but was mostly just an underneath option. His long gain went for just nine yards. McBride will remain a TE1 next week against the Commanders, but it’s fair to question the ceiling.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 5-of-5 targets for 37 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 10 loss to the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: Initially, it looked like McBride might not experience much of a drop-off with Carson Beck at the helm, catching 2-of-2 targets for 13 yards on the opening drive. The Cardinals’ offense then began to falter, and the Rams jumped out to a 17-6 lead by the end of the first half. From there, the Rams’ defense focused on flustering Beck, and the Cardinals’ rushing attack was unable to make them pay. McBride led the team in targets and will still be a TE1 next week against the Chiefs. As he and Beck hone their connection, his box score results may fluctuate more than we’d like in the coming weeks, though.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Carson Beck will start for the Cardinals in Week 10 against the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: With Jacoby Brissett in Baltimore and Gardner Minshew out because of a UCL injury, the Cardinals are already down to their third-string quarterback. It was almost a given that Beck would start at some point this year, though we imagine head coach Matt LaFleur didn’t think it would be this soon. Beck played well in his lone preseason appearance, throwing for 188 yards and a score. While he’s not much of a streaming option this week, he should be good enough to keep Trey McBride at the top of the TE1 ranks, especially with Michael Wilson done for the year.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 7-of-8 targets for 54 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 9 loss to the Seahawks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: The lone incompletion directed toward McBride came on the team’s final play of the game when the veteran tight end was unable to corral an end zone target that was thrown slightly behind him on fourth and goal. McBride combined with alpha wide receiver Michael Wilson to account for 15 targets on 30 Minshew pass attempts, something we’d expect to continue forward give the current state of the team. The Cardinals get another difficult matchup against the Rams in Week 10, where McBride will remain a surefire TE1 in fantasy circles.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports the Broncos checked on Trey McBride.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: To no one’s surprise, the Cardinals hung up the phone in record time. Even as a perennially rebuilding franchise, Arizona was never going to trade arguably the league’s best tight end in the middle of his prime. Schefter added that the Cardinals have “checked in around the league on tight ends.” Evan Engram has a measly 13 catches for 136 yards this year and Denver’s passing attack has taken a step back despite acquiring Jaylen Waddle in the offseason. Dallas Goedert is the biggest name believed to be available at tight end ahead of Tuesday’s deadline. On an expiring contract, he wouldn’t cost the Broncos much. Carolina tight end Ja’Tavion Sanders is likely on the trade block as well.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 7-of-8 targets for 72 yards and a touchdown in Arizona’s Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: McBride’s touchdown with 2:11 left seemed like it would be a bit of a fantasy afterthought, but it quickly proved important as the Cowboys fizzled out after a failed onside kick by Arizona. The veteran tight end caught four passes and 44 yards of this production, as well as the touchdown, once Jacoby Brissett left the game. He’ll remain a don’t-have-to-think-about-it TE1 even in a tough matchup against Seattle in Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 10-of-13 targets for 111 yards and a touchdown in the Cardinals’ Week 7 loss to the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: The Cardinals couldn’t get much going on offense, but that’s not a problem for McBride. He accounted for 27 percent of the team’s targets and was the only Cardinal to find the end zone on the day. McBride did so on a seven-yard strike from Brissett in the third quarter. Despite posting weekly TE1 numbers, this is McBride’s first 100-yard outing of the season. Facing a laughable Dallas defense next week, McBride will likely clock in as the TE1 overall in the weekly rankings.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 7-of-9 targets for 53 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 6 win over the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: McBride’s first target ended up being a Quentin Lake interception, but Jacoby Brissett went right back to his star tight end on the following drive. McBride made a contested catch on a quick in route, spun off contact and took off downfield for a 26-yard gain. McBride’s day largely consisted of out routes and catches in the flats after that, but he was given two opportunities to score a touchdown from inside the Rams’ 25-yard line on the Cardinals’ seventh drive. On 2nd-and-1 from the Rams’ 21-yard line, McBride caught a pass in the flats and rumbled through contact for a short first-down gain. Three plays later, on 3rd-and-goal from the Rams’ seven-yard line, Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur dialed up a screen pass for him, but the Rams blew it up, resulting in a yardage loss. It wasn’t McBride biggest outing, but a 7/53 is hardly unusable. McBride remains an elite TE1 against the Broncos next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: ArizonaCardinals.com’s Darren Urban believes Carson Beck won’t start in the “immediate future.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: Cardinals fans appear to be pining for the team to bench Jacoby Brissett and start the rookie in the coming weeks as another season circles the drain for Arizona. Beck so far has been the Cards’ emergency third quarterback. Urban said there remains a “chance Beck is made the backup this week or next and allow him to come on in relief if the situation presents itself. I don’t see Beck starting in the immediate future, but it does feel his time grows closer, and if the offense continues to sputter, that would be understandable.” Brissett this season ranks 15th in passing yards. He’s thrown nine touchdowns to five interceptions and ranks 30th out of 37 qualifying QBs in adjusted yards per attempt. He won’t be a viable fantasy play this week against a tough Rams coverage unit.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 9-of-10 targets for 66 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals’ Week 5 loss to the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: McBride looked like his normal, dominant self, carving up defenders on out routes and in-breakers. Unfortunately, hearts were also broken when Jacoby Brissett fired a touchdown pass right past McBride, running wide open inside the Lions’ five-yard line, to backup TE Teagan Quitoriano, also running wide open in the back of the end zone. Fortunately, McBride was able to haul in a juggling, falling and contested touchdown catch late in the fourth quarter to boost his final stat line. McBride is an elite TE1 against the Rams next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-w.headline: Harrison Wallace caught 4-of-7 targets for 57 yards in Arizona’s Week 11 loss to the Chiefs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-w.analysis: It was the 2026 UDFA’s third game in the pros. He played 29-of-49 snaps. Wallace caught Arizona’s longest gain of the day, a 25-yarder. We guess we have to take the idea that Wallace could move towards FLEX value seriously as they move on to the Commanders in Week 12, but it is hard to imagine much fantasy value coming out of this team for the rest of the year outside of Trey McBride.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-w.headline: Cardinals signed WR Harrison Wallace III.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-w.analysis: Wallace led the Rebels in receiving via a career-best stat line, 61/934/4, after transferring from Penn State to Ole Miss last year. He stands 6’/192 and turned 24 years old on Day 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft. Wallace primarily lined up on the perimeter in college and chipped in as a punt returner last year. He will probably need to secure a role as a special teams player and backup receiver to make the active roster.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed 27 times for 120 yards and two touchdowns in the Panthers’ Week 11 win over the Ravens.
Chuba Hubbard had 27 rushes for 92 yards and two touchdowns in the Panthers’ Week 10 win against the Saints, adding five catches for 72 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: The entire Carolina offense revolved around Hubbard in this one, as the Panthers ditched their pass-heavy approach for an ultra run-heavy offense against a middle New Orleans defense. Hubbard had a couple long plays and a touchdown called back on penalties too. He plodded along for much of the game before exploding for a long gain on a well-designed screen play late in the fourth quarter. Hubbard, who now has seven games with at least 17 rushes, has been one of the most reliable running backs in fantasy this season. That might change a bit when Jonathon Brooks returns from injury, perhaps in Week 11 against the Ravens.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed 16 times for 79 yards in the Panthers’ Week 9 loss to the Broncos, adding four receptions for 17 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: Hubbard’s 16 totes were his second fewest since Week 2, though fantasy managers will at least take the 96 yards from scrimmage. Handling huge workloads and snap counts, Hubbard hasn’t always maintained his efficiency under such voluminous usage, though we have yet to see any red flags in 2026. He will remain a strong option on the RB1/2 borderline for Week 10 against the Saints.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed 22 times for 81 yards and a touchdown in the Panthers’ Week 8 loss to the Packers, adding seven receptions for 38 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: Hubbard was easily the most effective offensive player for the Panthers, but that’s at least partially an insult to everyone else as much as it was compliment to him. The tailback was able to make the most of the limited rushing room, and with Bryce Young having zero time to throw the football, he was a frequent target of Young’s checkdowns. Trevor Etienne received just one carry for one yard, meanwhile. Hubbard’s usage makes him a high-end RB2 for Week 9 against the Broncos, even if it’s more floor than ceiling.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed seven times for 33 yards in the Panthers’ 43-13, Week 7 loss to the Bucs, adding four receptions for 27 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: With Bryce Young committing three turnovers — killing drives and setting up Bucs short fields that took the Panthers out of run-friendly game script — Hubbard had little shot at providing fantasy-friendly returns this afternoon unless he found the end zone late. He did not, with those honors going to “Anthony Tyus III” in garbage time. It was just one of those days in Charlotte. Thankfully the Panthers don’t have long to stew, as they must now get ready for a short-week Thursday evening road date with the Packers. With most Pack — and Panthers — games projecting as shootouts these days, Hubbard will remain safely ensconced in the high-end RB2 ranks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed 28 times for 120 yards and a touchdown in the Panthers’ Week 6 win over the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: It wasn’t easy for Hubbard, who didn’t have many runs over 10 yards, but he ran hard, broke tackles, and was able to find the end zone in the fourth quarter for a short touchdown run. Still, the Panthers did have some issues running the ball up the gut against the Eagles and continued to do it, rather than try to get Hubbard going on the edge. Trevor Etienne was the only other running back to have a carry in this game, and he had just one rush, so this backfield belongs entirely to Hubbard, which is tremendous for his fantasy value.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed 20 times for 122 yards and two touchdowns in the Panthers’ Week 4 win over the Lions, adding seven yards on one reception.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: Hubbard’s successes on the ground allowed the Panthers to remain balanced on a night they were without two of their top three wide receivers due to the absences of Jalen Coker and Xavier Legette, cashing in on two scores from 15 and two yards out. Hubbard appears to be locked into an RB1 workload in the absence of Jonathan Brooks, who will be out for 6-8 weeks after undergoing core muscle surgery. His 26 opportunities dwarfed the six of current backup AJ Dillon, the latter of whom gained just seven total yards on six touches. Fantasy managers can start Hubbard with confidence when the team returns from their bye to face the Eagles in Week 6.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed 19 times for 82 yards in the Panthers’ Week 3 loss to the Browns, adding four receptions for 28 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: With Jonathon Brooks on injured reserve, Hubbard’s 23 touches were nine more than he handled in Week 2, and 10 more than Week 1. Although he ceded a smattering of snaps to new backup AJ Dillon, he was a near every-down player in this road loss. Hubbard lacks high-end fantasy upside, but his floor right now is very much that of a locked-in RB2. That will be especially true for matchups like next week’s date with the defensively-challenged Lions.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Panthers will host a workout for Austin Ekeler, formerly of the Commanders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: Carolina is in need of some backfield reinforcements after losing Jonathon Brooks to a core injury that will leave him sidelined for at least six weeks. AJ Dillon is set to fill in for Brooks while Chub Hubbard presumably continues as the team’s lead back. Ekeler, 31, who hasn’t played since injuring his Achilles last September, could be an emergency running back if Hubbard or Dillon go down with injuries in the coming weeks. First he’ll need to make the squad.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed 12 times for 53 yards in the Panthers’ Week 2 win over the Falcons, adding two catches for 11 yards and a touchdown.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: Hubbard operated as the Panthers’ unquestioned RB1, out-carrying Jonathon Brooks 12-5. He got on the board early with a touchdown catch near the goal line. It was his second touchdown grab of the year and his third time finding the end zone in total. Brooks also left the game early with a groin injury and his status for Week 3 is up in the air. Hubbard was already going to project for RB2 numbers with Brooks in the middle. He will push to the middle of the RB2 pack if Brooks is out versus the Browns.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.headline: Jacoby Brissett completed 24-of-37 passes for 276 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the Ravens’ 35-33, Week 11 loss to the Panthers.
Jacoby Brissett completed 33-of-49 passes for 340 yards and one interception in the Ravens’ 23-20, Week 10 loss to the Chargers, adding two yards on two carries.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.analysis: Brissett and the Ravens played from behind throughout against the only team without a win through the first nine weeks of the 2026 season, but the veteran’s performance through the air kept the team within striking distance late into the fourth quarter. The defense did its job and gave the ball back to the Ravens with under three minutes remaining and Brissett had the team driving the field down by three before a Zay Flowers fumble cost them the game. For his part, Brissett settled into the game in the second quarter after three straight three-and-out possessions, ultimately falling just short in the defeat. Brissett will remain the starter under center for the next 6-10 weeks as Lamar Jackson recovers from surgery on his thumb, with his next opportunity to return a viable fantasy outing coming in Week 11 against the Panthers in what is a must-win game for the Ravens, losers of five straight.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.headline: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter released a statement saying Lamar Jackson (thumb) will be out for the next 6-10 weeks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.analysis: On the short end of this timeline, Jackson could return in Week 16 against the Browns. On the long end, Jackson would be looking at returning around the Wild Card or Divisional Round of the playoffs if the Ravens make the postseason. This timeline closely aligns with the 6-9 week absence NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reported earlier in the week. If this isn’t a season-ender for Lamar, it will be close, and how the Ravens perform over the next several weeks with Jacoby Brissett under center will likely determine whether the Ravens dress him for the final few weeks of the season, even if he is ready to go. Minter said that Jackson is “doing well” after suffering his injury in Week 8 against the Bills, which is encouraging, but we’re a long way from knowing if a return for Jackson is truly in the cards. The 4-5 Ravens have lost their last four games but hope to turn things around on Monday night when they play host to the Chargers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.headline: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said he expects Jacoby Brissett to start in Week 10 against the Chargers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.analysis: The Ravens wasted little time in trading for Brissett after he lost his starting job with the Cardinals. The 33-year-old journeyman is familiar with Ravens QB coach Israel Woolfork and was acquired in part because the team believed he could quickly become the starter. Brissett threw for 1,719 yards, 10 touchdowns, and seven interceptions in his eight games with the Cardinals this season, and will now look to save the Ravens’ season after they fell to 4-5 last week. With Lamar Jackson (finger) hoping to come back in the next six to nine weeks, if Baltimore can string together a few wins, it’s possible he will be back in time for the playoffs should they make the postseason. Brissett being under center should also provide some stability to Zay Flowers’ and Derrick Henry’s fantasy stocks after a rough few weeks sans Lamar.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.headline: The Ravens and Cardinals finalized a trade on Friday that sends Jacoby Brissett to Baltimore.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.analysis: We already knew this deal would be done, but the two sides made things official on Friday. The Ravens will receive Brissett, along with a 2027 fifth-round pick from the Cardinals in exchange for a 2027 4th-round pick and a 2028 7th-round pick. Brissett will immediately step into a starting role for the Ravens when they face the Chargers in Week 10 and should provide an immediate upgrade over Joe Fagnano, who struggled mightily in his first career start against the Jaguars.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.headline: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports that the Ravens are acquiring Jacoby Brissett from the Cardinals in a deal that is expected to be completed this weekend.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.analysis: Schefter adds that this trade will not be completed in time for Brissett to play in Week 9’s Thursday Night Football game for the Ravens, but he will make his debut in Week 10 against the Chargers. Brissett’s impending arrival in Baltimore immediately stabilizes the pass-catching corps’ fantasy value. The trade compensation has not yet been revealed, but we expect to know more soon.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.headline: Jacoby Brissett will serve as the Cardinals’ emergency QB3 in Week 9 against the Seahawks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.analysis: After holding out part of the offseason for a new deal that was fitting for a starting QB in the league, Brissett now finds himself as the QB3 of the Cardinals entering Week 9. There’s a good chance this is the end of the road for Brissett as far as his time with the Cardinals is concerned, as a handful of dire QB situations around the league could warrant a trade to a contender who is looking to upgrade at QB before the trade deadline. Brissett was solid last season for a three-win Cardinals team, throwing for 3,366 yards, 23 touchdowns, and eight interceptions in 12 starts. He currently sports a 1,719-10-7 line this season but has struggled in his last three starts, throwing just one touchdown to two interceptions. With Brissett being demoted to QB3, rookie Carson Beck will be elevated to QB2 on game days, and draws ever closer to making his first career start at some point in the season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.headline: Jacoby Brissett completed 10-of-23 passes for 119 yards and an interception before being benched for Gardner Minshew in the third quarter.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.analysis: He took four sacks, including back-to-back sacks to kill a third-quarter drive, before being replaced. Brissett hasn’t necessarily played this poorly all season, but we’d been getting plenty of questions at press conferences about if he’d remain the starter so we’re ultimately unsurprised by this move. Minshew took over and we assume Carson Beck will also be mentioned ahead of Week 9. Full Mike LaFleur press conference coverage to come, naturally.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.headline: Jacoby Brissett completed 27-of-48 passes for 272 yards and a touchdown in the Cardinals’ 30-16, Week 7 loss to the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.analysis: Brissett struggled to get the deep ball going in this game and was largely stuck dinking and dunking his way down the field. He averaged a measly 5.7 yards per attempt while completing 56.3 percent of his passes. Brissett hasn’t averaged seven yards per attempt in a game since Week 1. Even worse is the fact that he’s taking bone-crushing hits more than ever. Brissett injured his non-throwing hand while taking a sack late in the second quarter but never missed any time with the issue. We expect him to make an appearance on the injury report this week. Head coach Mike LaFleur told reporters after the game that Brissett remains the starter, meaning he’ll take on a terrible Dallas defense next week. He will be a priority streamer for Week 8.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.headline: Jacoby Brissett completed 24-of-35 passes for 218 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals’ 18-16, Week 6 win over the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jacoby-bri.analysis: Brissett threw an interception to Rams S Quentin Lake while targeting Trey McBride on the Cardinals’ third play from scrimmage but managed to play mistake-free and touchdown-free football from there on out. Brissett took zero sacks for the first time this season and linked up with four different players for explosive gains. That said, the box score results obviously disappoint. Brissett nearly linked up with Michael Wilson for a 36-yard touchdown on the Cardinals’ seventh drive, but the ball glanced off Wilson’s fingertips as he dove for it in the end zone. The drive ultimately resulted in a field goal, as did five others. Brissett will be a high-end QB2 against the Broncos in Week 7.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier rushed seven times for 23 yards in Arizona’s Week 11 loss to the Chiefs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: He out-snapped Bam Knight 26-23 in a committee that has managed to keep even a slim amount of fantasy value from coming to fruition. Allgeier has 259 rushing yards on the season if you exclude the week they played the Dallas Cowboys.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier rushed five times for 14 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 10 loss to the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: The Cardinals’ coaching staff gave Allgeier the chance to be the team’s lead rusher today. He botched it, eventually ceding carries to Bam Knight late in the game. Knight barely outplayed him. Allgeier failed to catch his lone target. He is just a FLEX option next week against the Chiefs.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Bam Knight will play in Week 10 against the Rams after clearing concussion protocol.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: After being upgraded to a full participant on Thursday, Knight is officially off of the injury report and good to go for Sunday’s game against the Rams. Both Knight and Tyler Allgeier are expected to factor heavily into the Cardinals’ running game this weekend, especially with Carson Beck making his first career start with a depleted receiving corps. Both Knight and Allgeier will be fringe RB3/Flex plays in a game that could prove tough for the Cardinals’ banged-up offense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier rushed 17 times for 46 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 9 loss to the Seahawks, gaining zero additional yards on two receptions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: In what was the first game as the clear starter for the Cardinals in the absence of both Jeremiyah Love and Bam Knight, Allgeier was contained to only 2.7 yards per carry as the offense managed under 200 yards of total offense against the stingy Seattle defense. Fantasy managers that were quick to scoop Allgeier off of waivers heading into Week 9 are surely to be disappointed with the returns, particularly considering Knight had largely outperformed the former prior to missing Week 9 with a concussion. Expect a near-even split backfield once Knight returns, which appears likely to be in Week 10 when the Cardinals face another difficult test in the Rams.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier rushed 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown in Arizona’s Week 8 win over the Cowboys, adding five catches for 44 yards and an additional touchdown.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: Allgeier was given reign of the backfield in the second half after Bam Knight (concussion) was ruled out and Jeremiyah Love (ankle) left early in the first half. He decided to take advantage of it with runs of 63 yards (for a score) and 52 yards to set up a very nice sideline tightrope touchdown on a reception. Allgeier was the only healthy back for the Cardinals at this point in the game and this isn’t the kind of performance we’ll see repeated, but he definitely could step in to an expanded role in Week 9 given the injuries around him. If he was dropped in your league, he’s a worthwhile waiver wire consideration.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier (toe) was removed from the injury report and will play in Week 8 against the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: Allgeier saw a steady progression in practice throughout the week, starting off with a “DNP” before upgrading in each subsequent session, culminating in a full practice Friday. He will be available to form a likely three-headed timeshare with Jeremiyah Love and Bam Knight against the Cowboys and likely does not warrant fantasy consideration.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier (toe) was a limited participant during Thursday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: Allgeier was able to get a bump up after a DNP for Wednesday. It appears to just be a case of rest for the 26-year-old, but fantasy managers who will consider Allgeier for Week 8 against the Cowboys if Jeremiyah Love (ankle) can’t go — Love was also limited Thursday — should keep an eye on Friday’s designation.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier (toe) did not practice Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: Allgeier popped up on the injury report with a toe issue as rookie Jeremiyah Love (ankle) returned to practice in a limited fashion. Though we don’t know the severity of Allgeier’s injury, it may be worth keeping Bam Knight rostered despite Love’s return. If Allgeier cannot play in Week 8 against the Cowboys, Knight will get another week of fantasy viability.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) will be limited on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: We were hoping to see Love practice in full after taking two weeks off. While today’s limited session puts him on track to play in Week 8 against the Cowboys, Bam Knight and Tyler Allgeier are still worth stashing on benches, just in case. The Cardinals are finally handling Love’s recovery patiently, after giving him far too many touches early in the preseason.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier rushed eight times for 19 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 7 loss to the Broncos, adding three catches for 30 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: Allgeier only saw one more carry than Bam Knight. Both backs caught three passes, but Knight was the recipient of five targets. Through two Jeremiyah Love absences, Allgeier has 26 carries for 57 yards. He’s barely playing ahead of Knight and has been the far less efficient member of the backfield. Knight has 128 yards on four fewer attempts. Even if Love is out again next week, Allgeier will barely crack the RB3 ranks versus Dallas.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Tyler Shough completed 25-of-42 attempts for 222 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the Saints’ 21-13 Week 11 loss to the Bears, adding three rushes for 34 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Shough and the Saints offense got off to another slow start. After a scoreless first quarter, Shough threw an interception in New Orleans territory in the second quarter. He was able to later connect with Alvin Kamara for a fourth-and-goal touchdown pass while a 30-yard scramble in the two minute drill led to a Saints field goal at the end of the half. The second half saw little offense from the Saints as they scored just one field goal the rest of the game. Shough failed to connect with Noah Fant on a crucial red zone fourth down and took a 13-yard sack in the two-minute drill at the end of the game. He averaged 5.3 yards per attempt in another inefficient showing. Shough belongs in the fantasy QB2 ranks for a Week 12 matchup against the Bengals.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Tyler Shough completed 25-of-35 attempts for 187 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the Saints’ Week 10 loss to the Panther, adding six rushes for 25 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Shough continued his wildly inefficient ways. He faced constant pressure from a Carolina front seven that entered the week with the league’s sixth lowest QB pressure rate, and missed short and intermediate throws throughout. Shough had a miserable aDOT of 4.5 and had a -8 total EPA on the day. The disjointed Saints offense doesn’t make things easy for Shough, but his total inability to make routine throws is having a real impact on Saints pass catchers. Shough should be considered a superflex-only option in Week 11 against the Bears.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Tyler Shough completed 21-of-35 passes for 265 yards and a touchdown in the Saints’ 23-22, Week 9 win over the Browns.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Shough got off to a dreadfully slow start, throwing for a measly 156 scoreless yards over the first three quarters. The Browns weren’t pushing the Saints to play fast or pass often, resulting in a noticeable lack of volume for Shough. A 64-yard touchdown for the Browns in the middle of the fourth quarter finally forced the Saints to pick up the pace. Shough responded with a 55-yard touchdown drive two series later, though Audric Estime found the end zone on the ground. Shough eventually closed out the game with a 15-yard touchdown strike to Juwan Johnson in overtime. Shough’s fantasy output is tied directly to his passing volume. He’ll remain at the top of the QB2 ranks as long as his defense keeps giving up points, which should happen versus the Panthers in Week 10.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Tyler Shough completed 30-of-38 passes for 273 yards with a touchdown and an interception in the Saints’ 16-10, Week 7 loss to the Steelers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Shough’s seven rushing yards led the team, which isn’t ideal. The 27-year-old was mostly accurate and on-time with his throws, but he should have had three turnovers in the first half — one dropped interception, one strip-sack that was overturned and one fumble that luckily went out of bounds — in addition to the one costly red-zone interception that actually made the stat sheet. It wasn’t Shough at his best, but there were some flashes of brilliance in the loss. Shough will get a bye week before he faces the Browns in Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Tyler Shough completed 16-of-30 passes for 144 yards and three touchdowns in the Saints’ 34-27, Week 6 win over the Giants, adding five carries for 32 yards and a touchdown.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: The Saints had their usual slow start on offense, going scoreless in the first quarter. Shough then did what he does best and led an effective offensive effort the rest of the way. He is dealing with broken bones in his non-throwing hand and it arguably impacted some of his throws, missing open receivers and struggling to push the ball downfield. Though he averaged 4.8 yards per attempt, he totaled three touchdowns on the day. Shough was also impactful as a runner, totaling 32 yards and a tush push touchdown on the day while also getting tackled inside the five-yard line on another rush. Two straight games have been impacted by Shough’s hand injury but the post-first quarter volume continues to elevate his fantasy floor. Shough is a high-end QB2 for Week 7 against the Steelers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports Tyler Shough has two broken bones in his non-throwing hand.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Both Shough and Kellen Moore have given non-answers when asked about the quarterback’s left hand. Per Schefter, the injury could take a couple of months to heal, but it will not cost him any playing time. Shough injured his hand versus the Falcons in Week 4 and wore a protective glove in Week 5. He is coming off his two worst games of the year, though we don’t suspect the hand is to blame. Things get much easier this week with the Giants on tap. Shough will get another shot at a QB1 finish in Week 6.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Saints coach Kellen Moore, asked directly if Tyler Shough’s non-throwing hand is broken, said “it got banged two weeks ago and he’s just wearing some protective layers there.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: So, probably, then. The hand hasn’t really been a contributing factor to New Orleans’ decline so much as the Saints offensive line has just been in the blender for two weeks against Atlanta and Minnesota’s fronts, but it sure looks like Shough is managing through something and we should probably break ties against him in the rankings.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Tyler Shough completed 16-of-25 passes for 96 yards and two interceptions in the Saints’ 23-13, Week 5 loss to the Vikings.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Shough had been coasting on extreme play volume over the first month of the fantasy season. Brian Flores and the Vikings’ hyper-aggressive defense had no issues shutting down that approach. The Saints had five drives in the first half. Only one lasted longer than three plays. Of their four second-half drives, two ended with interceptions. A fumbled kickoff coming out of the break didn’t help the team’s play volume either. Shough has ultimately been a better fantasy quarterback than a real-life passer this year and the Vikings’ defense exposed that truth for the better part of four quarters. He will look to rebound against a far worse Giants unit in Week 6.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Tyler Shough (hand) is not on New Orleans’ final Week 5 injury report.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: As expected, he’ll start and be on the QB1/QB2 borderline against an extremely pesky and attacking Vikings defense that has held down quarterback scoring quite well so far this year.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Tyler Shough (hand) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: As a right-handed quarterback, Shough should be fine despite his surprise appearance on the injury report. Even in a blowout loss on Monday, the second-year passer racked up 286 yards and a touchdown on 48 attempts. As long as the volume is there, Shough is good for low-end QB1 numbers. He will remain inside the top 12 at his position for Week 5 against Minnesota.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.headline: Bam Knight rushed seven times for 35 yards in Arizona’s Week 11 loss to the Chiefs, adding a catch on his only target for 10 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.analysis: Knight had three touches for three yards at halftime, but turned in a half-reasonable FLEX line once the Cardinals started running clock in the fourth quarter. He had 23 snaps to Tyler Allgeier’s 26. Even against the Commanders, this feels like a tough click in Week 12.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.headline: Bam Knight rushed five times for 19 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 10 loss to the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.analysis: Knight missed the Cardinals’ Week 9 game due to a concussion, but he had been working as the team’s primary rusher before that. Today, Tyler Allgeier handled that role, but his poor play resulted in more carries for Knight as the game progressed. Early in the fourth quarter, Knight snuck past his coverage defender on a route out of the backfield, running down the left sideline. Carson Beck slightly overthrew him, but Knight should have attempted to dive for what could have been roughly a 25-yard catch. It’s possible he lost the pass in the stadium lights. He earned two targets on the day, catching neither. Knight is a touchdown-dependent FLEX against the Chiefs in Week 11.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.headline: Bam Knight will play in Week 10 against the Rams after clearing concussion protocol.
